         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[LEC_GRP_MVT_ENVELOPPE_PER]
         /* Reconstitution des mouvements d'une enveloppe entre 2 dates */
         (@ID_ENVELOPPE integer,
         @DAT_DEBUT	datetime,
         @DAT_FIN	datetime)
         AS
         
         BEGIN
         	SET NOCOUNT ON
         
         	/* D‚finition automatique des dates de d‚but et de fin si elles ne sont pas fournies */
         	select
         		@DAT_DEBUT = case when (@DAT_DEBUT is null)
         			then PERIODE.DAT_DEB_PERIODE
         			else @DAT_DEBUT
         		end,
         		@DAT_FIN = case when (@DAT_FIN is null)
         			then PERIODE.DAT_FIN_PERIODE
         			else @DAT_FIN
         		end
         	from
         		PERIODE
         			inner join ENVELOPPE on ENVELOPPE.ID_PERIODE = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
         									and ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE = @ID_ENVELOPPE
         	
         	DECLARE
         	@ID_ADHERENT		integer,
         	@LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE varchar(50),
         	@LIBL_ENVELOPPE varchar(50),
         	@ID			integer, 
         	@MNT_MVT	decimal(18,2),
         	@MNT_SOLDE	decimal(18,2),
         	@BLN_OK		tinyint,
         	@MNT_SOLDE_SAV decimal(18,2),
         	@P_E_R varchar(1),
         	@P_E_R_SAV varchar(1)
         
         	DECLARE @NIV_DEBUG tinyint
         	SELECT @NIV_DEBUG = 0
         
         
         	IF @NIV_DEBUG >= 1
         	BEGIN
         		SELECT DAT_DEBUT = @DAT_DEBUT	
         		SELECT DAT_FIN = @DAT_FIN	
         	END
         
         	SELECT @DAT_DEBUT	= @DAT_DEBUT		+ 1
         	SELECT @DAT_FIN		= @DAT_FIN			+ 1
         
         
         	SET @BLN_OK = 0
         
         
         	SELECT @LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE = NULL
         
         	SELECT @LIBL_ENVELOPPE = LIBL_ENVELOPPE
         	FROM ENVELOPPE
         	WHERE ID_ENVELOPPE = @ID_ENVELOPPE
         
         	SET @BLN_OK = 1
         
         	IF @BLN_OK = 1
         	BEGIN
         
         		IF @NIV_DEBUG >= 1
         		BEGIN
         			PRINT '-- Liste des mouvements pour l''enveloppe'
         			SELECT MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, NUM_ANNEE, ID_ADHERENT, MNT_MVT_SIRIUS = MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, LIBC_TYPE_MOUVEMENT, P_E_R, SENS
         			FROM MVT_BUDGETAIRE MVT, EVENEMENT, ENVELOPPE, TYPE_ENVELOPPE, TYPE_MOUVEMENT, PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE, PERIODE
         			WHERE MVT.ID_EVENEMENT = EVENEMENT.ID_EVENEMENT
         			AND MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE= ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         			AND ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE = TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE
         			AND MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
         			AND PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
         			AND PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE = TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE
         			AND ENVELOPPE.ID_PERIODE = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
         			AND ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE = @ID_ENVELOPPE 
         		--	AND P_E_R = 'R'
         			ORDER BY NUM_ANNEE, DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, P_E_R
         		END
         
         		IF @NIV_DEBUG >= 1
         		BEGIN 
         			PRINT '-- Liste des differentes periode par type (engage, previsionnel, reel)'
         		END
         
         		SELECT DISTINCT ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE, 
         						PERIODE.ID_PERIODE, 
         						PERIODE.NUM_ANNEE, 
         						CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) MNT_INITIAL_P,
         						CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) MNT_FINAL_P,
         						CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) MNT_INITIAL_E,
         						CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) MNT_FINAL_E,
         						CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) MNT_INITIAL_R,
         						CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) MNT_FINAL_R
         		INTO #TMP_CPT_INIT
         		FROM ENVELOPPE, MVT_BUDGETAIRE, PERIODE
         		WHERE ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE = @ID_ENVELOPPE
         		AND ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE = MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         		AND ENVELOPPE.ID_PERIODE = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
         		AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE >= @DAT_DEBUT
         		AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_FIN
         
         		IF @NIV_DEBUG >= 1
         		BEGIN
         			SELECT * FROM #TMP_CPT_INIT
         		END
         
         
         		-- Calcul des montants initiaux sur les differentes enveloppes (somme des mouvements avant la date de prise en compte)
         		UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT 
         		SET MNT_INITIAL_P = TMP_INIT.MNT_INITIAL_P
         		FROM
         			( SELECT TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE, SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE) MNT_INITIAL_P
         			FROM #TMP_CPT_INIT TMP01, ENVELOPPE, MVT_BUDGETAIRE
         			WHERE 
         				TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         			AND ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE = MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         			AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_DEBUT
         			AND P_E_R = 'P'
         			GROUP BY TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE) TMP_INIT
         		WHERE #TMP_CPT_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE= TMP_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         
         		UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT 
         		SET MNT_INITIAL_E = TMP_INIT.MNT_INITIAL_E
         		FROM
         			( SELECT TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE, SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE) MNT_INITIAL_E
         			FROM #TMP_CPT_INIT TMP01, ENVELOPPE, MVT_BUDGETAIRE
         			WHERE	
         				TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         			AND ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE = MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_ENVELOPPE 
         			AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_DEBUT
         			AND P_E_R = 'E'
         			GROUP BY TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE) TMP_INIT
         		WHERE #TMP_CPT_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE = TMP_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         
         		UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT 
         		SET MNT_INITIAL_R = TMP_INIT.MNT_INITIAL_R
         		FROM
         			( SELECT TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE, SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE) MNT_INITIAL_R
         			FROM #TMP_CPT_INIT TMP01, ENVELOPPE, MVT_BUDGETAIRE
         			WHERE
         				TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         			AND ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE= MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         			AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_DEBUT
         			AND P_E_R = 'R'
         			GROUP BY TMP01.ID_ENVELOPPE) TMP_INIT
         		WHERE #TMP_CPT_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE= TMP_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         
         UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT SET MNT_INITIAL_E = MNT_INITIAL_E + MNT_INITIAL_R
         UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT SET MNT_INITIAL_P = MNT_INITIAL_P + MNT_INITIAL_E
         
         
         		CREATE TABLE #TMP_MVT
         		(ID integer not null identity,
         		ID_ENVELOPPE integer,
         		ID_ADHERENT integer,
         		LIBL_RAISON_SOCIALE varchar(50),
         		DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE datetime, 
         		NUM_ANNEE integer,
         		MNT_MVT decimal(18,2), 
         		MNT_DEBIT decimal(18,2),
         		MNT_CREDIT decimal(18,2),
         		LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE varchar(60),
         		LIBL_PERIODE varchar(50),
         		P_E_R	varchar(1)
         		)
         
         
         		/* Recuperation des mouvements entre les 2 tables dans une table temporaire */
         		INSERT INTO #TMP_MVT
         		(	ID_ENVELOPPE, 	
         			ID_ADHERENT, 
         			LIBL_RAISON_SOCIALE,
         			DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, 
         			NUM_ANNEE , 
         			MNT_MVT , 
         			MNT_DEBIT ,
         			MNT_CREDIT ,
         			LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, 
         			LIBL_PERIODE, 	
         			P_E_R)
         		SELECT 
         			MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE, 
         			MVT.ID_ADHERENT, 
         			NULL,
         			MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, 
         			PERIODE.NUM_ANNEE, 
         			MNT_MVT_SIRIUS = MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 
         			MNT_DEBIT = MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
         			MNT_CREDIT = MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
         			LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = ISNULL(LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, ''),
         			LIBL_PERIODE = 'Ann‚e ' + CAST(NUM_ANNEE AS VARCHAR), 
         			P_E_R
         		FROM MVT_BUDGETAIRE MVT, EVENEMENT, ENVELOPPE, TYPE_ENVELOPPE, TYPE_MOUVEMENT, PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE, PERIODE
         		WHERE MVT.ID_EVENEMENT = EVENEMENT.ID_EVENEMENT
         		AND MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE
         		AND ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE = TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE
         		AND MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
         		AND PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
         		AND PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE = TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE
         		AND ENVELOPPE.ID_PERIODE = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
         		AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE >= @DAT_DEBUT
         		AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_FIN
         		ORDER BY NUM_ANNEE, DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, P_E_R
         
         
         /* Recalcul des soldes finaux */
         	UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT
         	SET MNT_FINAL_R = MNT_INITIAL_R + SOLDE_MVT.SOLDE
         	FROM
         	(SELECT	#TMP_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE, ISNULL(SUM ((CASE P_E_R WHEN 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)* (MNT_CREDIT - MNT_DEBIT) ),0)  SOLDE
         	FROM #TMP_MVT 
         	GROUP BY #TMP_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         	) SOLDE_MVT
         	WHERE SOLDE_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE = #TMP_CPT_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         
         
         
         	UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT
         	SET MNT_FINAL_E = MNT_INITIAL_E + SOLDE_MVT.SOLDE
         	FROM
         	(SELECT	#TMP_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE, ISNULL(SUM ((CASE P_E_R WHEN 'P' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)* (MNT_CREDIT - MNT_DEBIT) ),0)  SOLDE
         	FROM #TMP_MVT 
         	GROUP BY #TMP_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         	) SOLDE_MVT
         	WHERE SOLDE_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE = #TMP_CPT_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         
         	UPDATE #TMP_CPT_INIT
         	SET MNT_FINAL_P = MNT_INITIAL_P + SOLDE_MVT.SOLDE
         	FROM
         	(SELECT	#TMP_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE, ISNULL(SUM ((MNT_CREDIT - MNT_DEBIT) ),0)  SOLDE
         	FROM #TMP_MVT 
         	GROUP BY #TMP_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         	) SOLDE_MVT
         	WHERE SOLDE_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE = #TMP_CPT_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE
         
         
         /* Fin Recalcul des soldes finaux */
         
         
         	SELECT ID_ADHERENT = #TMP_MVT.ID_ADHERENT, 
         			LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE = ADHERENT.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE, 
         			LIBL_PERIODE = #TMP_MVT.LIBL_PERIODE, 
         			MNT_INITIAL_P = #TMP_CPT_INIT.MNT_INITIAL_P, 
         			MNT_INITIAL_E = #TMP_CPT_INIT.MNT_INITIAL_E, 
         			MNT_INITIAL_R = #TMP_CPT_INIT.MNT_INITIAL_R, 
         			DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TMP_MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, 
         			LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TMP_MVT.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, 
         			P_E_R,
         			MNT_DEBIT, 
         			MNT_CREDIT, 
         			MNT_FINAL_P, 
         			MNT_FINAL_E, 
         			MNT_FINAL_R, 
         			ID_ENVELOPPE = #TMP_MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE,
         			LIBL_ENVELOPPE = @LIBL_ENVELOPPE
         	FROM #TMP_MVT
         		INNER JOIN #TMP_CPT_INIT ON #TMP_MVT .ID_ENVELOPPE = #TMP_CPT_INIT.ID_ENVELOPPE 
         		LEFT OUTER JOIN ADHERENT ON #TMP_MVT .ID_ADHERENT = ADHERENT.ID_ADHERENT
         	ORDER BY #TMP_MVT .ID_ENVELOPPE, #TMP_MVT.LIBL_PERIODE, DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE, #TMP_MVT.ID_ADHERENT
         	END
         
         END

         create PROCEDURE [dbo].[EDI_TRANSCO_CTL_EXISTE_ID_DEFAUT] 
         /* 
           Controle que l'identifiant par defaut associee  une table concernee par la transcodification dans le cadre de l'EDI 
           correspond  un identifiant prsent dans cette table.
         */  
         @ID_TABLE		VARCHAR(255),
         @ID_FAF			INTEGER
         AS
         
         BEGIN
         SET ROWCOUNT 0
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         
         DECLARE @COD_TABLE_FAF		VARCHAR(255),
         	@COD_FAF 		VARCHAR(8),
         	@LIBC_FAF 		VARCHAR(20),
         	@ID_TABLE_FAF_DEFAUT	INTEGER,
         	@LIB			VARCHAR(2000)
         	CREATE TABLE #TMP02
         	(
         		ID_FAF 	INTEGER		NULL,
         		COD_FAF 	VARCHAR(8)	NULL,
         		LIBC_FAF 	VARCHAR(20)	NULL
         	)
         
         	SELECT @COD_TABLE_FAF = name
         	FROM	sysobjects
         	WHERE	type = 'U'
         	AND	id = @ID_TABLE
         	
         
         	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
         	BEGIN		
         		SET @LIB = 'INSERT INTO #TMP02 '
         		SET @LIB = @LIB + 'SELECT ID_' + @COD_TABLE_FAF + ' ID , COD_' + @COD_TABLE_FAF + ' COD , LIBC_' + @COD_TABLE_FAF + ' LIBC  '
         		SET @LIB = @LIB + ' FROM ' + @COD_TABLE_FAF
         		SET @LIB = @LIB + ' WHERE ID_' + @COD_TABLE_FAF + ' = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @ID_FAF)
         		EXECUTE (@LIB)
         
         		SELECT @COD_TABLE_FAF COD_TABLE_FAF, ID_FAF, COD_FAF, LIBC_FAF 
         		FROM #TMP02
         	
         	END
         
         END

- Trace: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[EDT_ORDRES_VIREMENT_RECAP_AMOUNTS]
          @StartDate DATETIME,
          @EndDate DATETIME,
          @Reedit  INT,
          @UserID  INT
         -- =============================================
         -- HBO - #652 - Amounts for activities and subvention
         -- =============================================
         AS
         BEGIN
          DECLARE
           @ActivitiesAndAmounts TABLE
           (
            Code  VARCHAR(8),
            Amount  DECIMAL(18,2),
            DateDebut DATETIME,
            DateFin  DATETIME,
            Reedition INT,
            UserID  INT,
            OrderNumber INT
           )
          
          ;with ActivitiesAndAmounts as
             (
           SELECT DISTINCT
            LIBC_ACTIVITE AS Code,
            sum(dbo.GetMontantReglementSplit(R.ID_REGLEMENT,A.ID_ACTIVITE, null, 1)) AS Amount,
            @StartDate AS DATE_DEBUT,
            @EndDate AS DATE_FIN,
            @Reedit  AS REEDITION,
            @UserID  AS ID_UTILISATEUR,
            NUM_ORDRE AS OrderNumber
           FROM
            REGLEMENT R
            CROSS APPLY ACTIVITE A
           WHERE
            R.BLN_ACTIF = 1
            AND 
            (
             (
              @Reedit = 1
              AND R.DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT IS NOT NULL
              AND (@StartDate IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(DAY,R.DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT,@StartDate) <= 0)
              AND (@EndDate  IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(DAY,R.DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT,@EndDate ) >= 0)
             )
             OR
             (
              @Reedit <> 1

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[LEC_PRC_VIR_SELECTIONNEES_ANNULEES]
         AS
         BEGIN
         	DECLARE @PRC AS DECIMAL(18,2)
         
         	DECLARE @NUMERATEUR AS DECIMAL(18,2)
         	DECLARE @DENOMINATEUR AS DECIMAL(18,2)
         	SET @NUMERATEUR = 
         	(
         		SELECT 	COUNT(REGLEMENT.ID_REGLEMENT)
         		FROM	REGLEMENT
         		WHERE	REGLEMENT.BLN_EN_COURS = 1 AND
         				REGLEMENT.BLN_CRITERE = 1 AND
         				REGLEMENT.BLN_ACTIF = 0
         	)
         
         	SET @DENOMINATEUR = 
         	(
         		SELECT 	COUNT(REGLEMENT.ID_REGLEMENT)
         		FROM	REGLEMENT
         		WHERE	REGLEMENT.BLN_EN_COURS = 1 AND
         				REGLEMENT.BLN_CRITERE = 1
         	)
         
         	 
         		IF @DENOMINATEUR = 0
         			SET @PRC = 0
         
         		IF @DENOMINATEUR != 0 
         			SET @PRC = @NUMERATEUR/@DENOMINATEUR
         	
         
         	SELECT 'Return Value' = COALESCE(ROUND(@PRC,2),0)
         END

         -- LE 24/05/2012 par DSZ - 13501 - ne pas prendre en compte les modules cl“tur‚s  
         -- =======================================================================================================================================  
         -- OPA #219 En tant qu'utilisateur habilit‚ Optiform, lorsque je consulte la liste des dossiers PEC engageables, je veux que seuls les 
         -- modules ayant des piŠces Bloquant l'engagement absentes ou non conformes soient r‚pertori‚s en "PiŠce manquante"
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- Author  : MBL  
         -- Modified date: 21/08/2014
         -- OBJET : Prise en compte des PCE avec Montant demand‚ … 0
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- Author  : MBL  
         -- Modified date: 24/09/2014
         -- OBJET : Blocage du BAE si des PCE non approuves et sans PFUS sont associes a l'action
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- Author  : MBL  
         -- Modified date: 05/01/2015
         -- OBJET : Blocage du BAE si D‚synchro entre Activit‚ Historis‚e du Stagiaire et Activit‚ du dispositif PLAN
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- Author  : MBL  
         -- Modified date: 16/06/2015
         -- OBJET : Le Blocage du BAE si D‚synchro entre Activit‚ Historis‚e du Stagiaire et Activit‚ du dispositif PLAN 
         --         n'est effectue que sur les modules actifs
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- Author  : MB
         -- Modif. date  : 13/08/2015
         -- Description  : Correction gestion des piŠces absentes ou non conformes bloquant l'engagement 
         --                Correction adaptation faite sur US # 219 mal g‚r‚e
         --                Un module dont une (ou +sieurs) piŠce active est absente doit positionner le module en PiŠce manquante et bloquer son engagement 
         --                ce qui n'est plus le cas … ce jour
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- DSZ 20/01/2016 #1123
         -- Ajout statut "Absence lien CPF"
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- OPA 02/03/2016 #1012
         -- En tant que gestionnaire Engagement, depuis l'‚cran de validation des BAE, je veux engager des actions CPF et non CPF.
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- MOU/OPA 03/03/2016 #1056
         -- En tant que gestionnaire Engagement CPF, sur l'‚cran BAE, je veux savoir que la validation d'un dossier CDC est en erreur
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- DSZ 07/03/2016 #1079 ajout @ID_ACTION
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- OPA 01/04/2016 #1123 1123 En tant que gestionnaire Engagement CPF, sur l'‚cran BAE, je ne peux pas engager une action d'un module avec 
         -- au moins une heure sur le dispositif CPF, s'il n'est pas li‚ … un dossier CDC
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- MOU 11/04/2016 #1079 Utilisation de la nouvelle table DEMANDE_CDC pour le calcul du Statut
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         -- BKE 28/04/2016 #1433 Int‚gration de scripts MBL (voir en dessous)
         -- Author  : MBL
         -- Modif. date  : 21/04/2016
         -- Description  : Blocage du BAE si un des modules … engager n'a jamais ete engage et que la date de cloture comptable de son millesime est d‚pass‚e 
         -- =======================================================================================================================================
         BEGIN  
           
          SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
          
          DECLARE @ID_PERIODE_ECHUE  INT  
          -- Declaration variable locale du paramŠtre  
          DECLARE @LOC_ID_UTILISATEUR INT  
          SET  @LOC_ID_UTILISATEUR = @ID_UTILISATEUR --Utiliser cette variable locale comme entr‚e dans les requˆtes  
           
          -- Recherche de la derniere periode de collecte (periode echue)  
          SELECT TOP 1 @ID_PERIODE_ECHUE = ID_PERIODE   
          FROM PERIODE   
          WHERE ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1  
          AND  GETDATE() >= DAT_COLLECTE_LIMITE_RELIQUAT  
          ORDER BY NUM_ANNEE DESC  
           
          
          DECLARE @AttenteBAE TABLE
         (
           ID_ACTION_PEC int, 
           MNT_A_ENGAGER_HT decimal(18,2),
           CIBLE_ACTION tinyint,  
           ID_ADHERENT int,  
           ADHERENT VARCHAR(255),  
           BLN_OK_FINANCEMENT  tinyint,  
           BLN_OK_PIECE tinyint,
           BLN_OK_ENGAGEMENT tinyint,  
           ENGAGEMENT_POSSIBLE VARCHAR(50),  
           BLN_ETABLISSEMENT_OF tinyint,
           BLN_OF tinyint
         )
         
          -- Recuperation des actions en attente de BAE dans la table @AttenteBAE  
          insert into @AttenteBAE
          (
          ID_ACTION_PEC , 
           MNT_A_ENGAGER_HT,
           CIBLE_ACTION ,  
           BLN_OK_FINANCEMENT  ,  
           BLN_OK_PIECE ,
           BLN_OK_ENGAGEMENT ,  
           BLN_ETABLISSEMENT_OF ,
           BLN_OF 
          )
          SELECT  
          MODULE_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC,  
          MNT_A_ENGAGER_HT = ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(PLAN_FINANCEMENT_US.MNT_PLAN_FINANCEMENT_US,0)),0) ,  
          CIBLE_ACTION = MIN(ACTION_PEC.CIBLE_ACTION),  
          BLN_OK_FINANCEMENT  = MIN(BLN_OK_FINANCEMENT),  
          BLN_OK_PIECE = MIN(MODULE_PEC.BLN_OK_PIECE),
           -- OPA 07/04/2014
          BLN_OK_ENGAGEMENT = MIN(COALESCE(PIECEMODULEPEC.BLN_OK_ENGAGEMENT, 1)),  
           -- BBL 06/06/2011
          BLN_ETABLISSEMENT_OF = MIN(ISNULL( ETABLISSEMENT_OF.BLN_ACTIF , 1)),
          BLN_OF = MIN(ISNULL( ORGANISME_FORMATION.BLN_ACTIF , 1))   
           FROM MODULE_PEC 
          INNER JOIN ACTION_PEC   ON ACTION_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC    = MODULE_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC   
           INNER JOIN POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE ON POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE.ID_MODULE_PEC   = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC
           -- MBL Modif du  24/09/2014 : Blocage du BAE si des PCE non approuves et sans PFUS sont associes a l'action
           -- INNER JOIN PLAN_FINANCEMENT_US ON POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE.ID_POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE = PLAN_FINANCEMENT_US.ID_POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE  
           LEFT JOIN PLAN_FINANCEMENT_US ON POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE.ID_POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE = PLAN_FINANCEMENT_US.ID_POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE  
           -- OPA 07/04/2014
           LEFT JOIN 
           (SELECT ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC, 
           0 AS BLN_OK_ENGAGEMENT
             FROM ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC 
             INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC ON MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC AND BLN_OK_PIECE = 0
             INNER JOIN PIECE_PEC ON PIECE_PEC.ID_PIECE_PEC = ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.ID_PIECE_PEC   
             AND PIECE_PEC.BLN_BLOQUANT_ENGAGEMENT = 1
             AND
             (
           ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.BLN_ACTIF = 0
           OR ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.BLN_CONFORME = 0
             )
           -- Modif MB . du 13/08/2015 : Correction gestion des piŠces absentes ou non conformes bloquant l'engagement 
           --WHERE ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.BLN_ACTIF = 1
           AND PIECE_PEC.BLN_ACTIF = 1   
             GROUP BY ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC) PIECEMODULEPEC ON PIECEMODULEPEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC 
          -- BBL 06/06/2011  
          LEFT JOIN ETABLISSEMENT_OF  ON ETABLISSEMENT_OF.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF = MODULE_PEC.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF AND MODULE_PEC.BLN_EXTERNE = 1  
          LEFT JOIN ORGANISME_FORMATION   ON ORGANISME_FORMATION.ID_OF = ETABLISSEMENT_OF.ID_OF  
          WHERE 
          (@ID_ACTION is not null OR ACTION_PEC.ID_UTILISATEUR   = @LOC_ID_UTILISATEUR) -- derniŠre modification a ‚t‚ r‚alis‚e par l'utilisateur pass‚ en paramŠtre @LOC_ID_UTILISATEUR   
          AND (@ID_ACTION is null or ACTION_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC = @ID_ACTION)
          AND  ACTION_PEC.BLN_ACTIF = 1     -- Actions actives  
          AND  ACTION_PEC.DAT_CLOTURE IS NULL    -- Actions non cloturees  
          AND  ACTION_PEC.BLN_CYCLE_COURT = 0     -- Actions en cycle court  
          AND  MODULE_PEC.BLN_IMPUTABLE = 1     -- Modules imputables  
          AND  MODULE_PEC.BLN_ACTIF = 1     -- Modules actifs  
          AND  POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE.ID_ENGAGEMENT IS NULL    -- Postes de cout non engages  
          AND  POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE.DAT_DESENGAGEMENT IS NULL    -- Postes de cout non desengages  
          
          -- MBL Modif du 21/08/2014 : Prise en compte des PCE avec Monatnt demand‚ … 0
          -- AND COALESCE (POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE.MNT_PREVISIONNEL_HT,0) <> 0   
          AND COALESCE (POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE.MNT_PREVISIONNEL_HT,0) >= 0   
          AND  MODULE_PEC.DAT_CLOTURE IS NULL       --suite … l'evol cloture du module DSZ 24/05/2012  
          GROUP BY MODULE_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC 
           
          -- Recherche du code et du libelle des adherents pour les actions individuelles  
          UPDATE @AttenteBAE  
          SET  ID_ADHERENT = ETABLISSEMENT .ID_ADHERENT,  
               ADHERENT = CAST(ADHERENT.COD_ADHERENT AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' ' + ADHERENT.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE  
          FROM  @AttenteBAE A
          INNER JOIN NR140   ON A.ID_ACTION_PEC = NR140.ID_ACTION_PEC 
          INNER JOIN ETABLISSEMENT ON ETABLISSEMENT.ID_ETABLISSEMENT = NR140 .ID_ETABLISSEMENT   
          INNER JOIN ADHERENT  ON ETABLISSEMENT.ID_ADHERENT   = ADHERENT .ID_ADHERENT  
          WHERE A.CIBLE_ACTION = 1  
              
           
          -- Calcul du montant collect‚ surl'activite PROF et la periode de collecte echue par les adherents  
          -- pour les actions individuelles  
          SELECT  SUM(POSTE_IMPUTATION.MNT_HT)    AS COLLECTE_VERSEE,    
            POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_ADHERENT_BENEFICIAIRE AS ID_ADHERENT_BENEFICIAIRE  
          INTO #COLLECTE_PCR  
          FROM  POSTE_IMPUTATION  
          INNER JOIN POSTE_VERSEMENT  ON POSTE_IMPUTATION.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT  = POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT  
          INNER JOIN VERSEMENT   ON POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT    = VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT  
          INNER JOIN @AttenteBAE A on POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_ADHERENT_BENEFICIAIRE = A.ID_ADHERENT 
          INNER JOIN ACTIVITE on POSTE_IMPUTATION.ID_ACTIVITE = ACTIVITE.ID_ACTIVITE 
          WHERE ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE = 'PRO'

         	DECLARE @ADHERENT_COUNT INT

         		SELECT ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.ID_ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC	
         		INTO #TEMP_LIST
         		FROM NR210
         		INNER JOIN	ACTION_PEC			ON	ACTION_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC				=	@ID_ACTION
         		INNER JOIN	MODULE_PEC			ON	MODULE_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC				=   @ID_ACTION
         		INNER JOIN	ETABLISSEMENT		ON	ETABLISSEMENT.ID_ETABLISSEMENT			=	@ID_ETABLISSEMENT

         		INNER JOIN	PIECE_PEC			ON	PIECE_PEC.ID_PIECE_PEC					=	ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.ID_PIECE_PEC
         		WHERE								ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC.ID_ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC	=	NR210.ID_ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC
         								
         
         		DELETE FROM NR210				WHERE ID_ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC IN (SELECT ID_ARRIVEE_PIECE_PEC FROM  #TEMP_LIST)

         -- Recƒblage des mouvements budgetaire de cl“ture d'action
         -- =============================================
         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[UPD_ACTION_CLOTURE]
         	@ID_ACTION_PEC			INT,
         	@ID_MOTIF_CLOTURE_PEC	INT,
         	@ID_UTILISATEUR			INT,
         	@ID_AGENCE_CLOTURE		INT = NULL,
         	@NUM_ARCHIVE			VARCHAR(17) OUT
         AS
         BEGIN
         	BEGIN TRY
         		DECLARE
         			@COMPTEUR INT,
         			@COD_AGENCE VARCHAR(8)
         
         		IF(@ID_AGENCE_CLOTURE IS NULL)
         		BEGIN
         			SELECT
         				@ID_AGENCE_CLOTURE = ID_AGENCE
         			FROM
         				UTILISATEUR
         			WHERE
         				ID_UTILISATEUR = @ID_UTILISATEUR
         		END
         	
         		IF (@ID_MOTIF_CLOTURE_PEC <> 0)
         		BEGIN
         			BEGIN TRANSACTION
         		
         			EXEC @COMPTEUR = [dbo].[GET_COMPTEUR_SUIVANT] 'NUM_ARCHIVE'
         		
         			SELECT @COD_AGENCE = COD_AGENCE FROM AGENCE WHERE ID_AGENCE = @ID_AGENCE_CLOTURE
         	
         			SELECT @NUM_ARCHIVE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @COMPTEUR) + '/' + @cod_agence
         	
         			UPDATE
         				ACTION_PEC
         			SET
         				ID_MOTIF_CLOTURE_PEC = @ID_MOTIF_CLOTURE_PEC,
         				DAT_CLOTURE = GetDate(),
         				DAT_MODIF = GetDate(),
         				ID_UTILISATEUR = @ID_UTILISATEUR,
         				ID_AGENCE_CLOTURE = @ID_AGENCE_CLOTURE,
         				NUM_ARCHIVE = @NUM_ARCHIVE
         			WHERE
         				ID_ACTION_PEC = @ID_ACTION_PEC
         
         			--	D‚branchement Mvts Budg‚taires pour cl“ture action PEC
         			-- LDE 05/08/2014 #145
         			EXEC INS_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CLOTURE_ACTION_PEC @ID_ACTION_PEC, @ID_UTILISATEUR;
         
         			COMMIT
         		END
         	END TRY
         	BEGIN CATCH
         		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
         			ROLLBACK
         		
         		SET @NUM_ARCHIVE = NULL
         				
         		DECLARE
         			@ErrMsg nvarchar(4000),
         			@ErrSeverity int
         
         		SELECT
         			@ErrMsg = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
         			@ErrSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
         
         		RAISERROR(@ErrMsg, @ErrSeverity, 1)
         	END CATCH
         END

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[UPD_ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_DANS_SESSION_PRO]
         	@ID_SESSION_PRO INT,
         	@ID_REGLEMENT_PRO INT
         AS
         BEGIN
         
         --		UPDATE SESSION_PRO 
         --		set ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_ADH=null,
         --			ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_OF=null  
         --		where ID_SESSION_PRO=@ID_SESSION_PRO
         
         
         declare @ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_of int
         declare @ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_adh int
         declare @dat_valid_reglement_OF as datetime
         set @dat_valid_reglement_OF = null
         declare @dat_valid_reglement_ADH as datetime
         set @dat_valid_reglement_ADH = null

         where (id_reglement_pro_of = @ID_REGLEMENT_PRO or id_reglement_pro_adh=@ID_REGLEMENT_PRO)
         and id_session_pro=@id_session_pro
         
         select @dat_valid_reglement_OF=dat_valid_reglement from reglement_pro where id_reglement_pro = @ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_OF
         select @dat_valid_reglement_ADH=dat_valid_reglement from reglement_pro where id_reglement_pro = @ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_ADH
         
         	IF @dat_valid_reglement_OF is null and @dat_valid_reglement_adh is null
         	BEGIN
         		if (@ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_adh is not null) 
         			UPDATE SESSION_PRO 
         			set ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_ADH=null  
         			where ID_SESSION_PRO=@ID_SESSION_PRO
         				and id_reglement_pro_adh= @ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_adh
         		
         		if (@ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_of is not null) 
         			UPDATE SESSION_PRO 
         			set ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_OF=null
         			where ID_SESSION_PRO=@ID_SESSION_PRO
         			and id_reglement_pro_of= @ID_REGLEMENT_PRO_of
         	END
         
         
         END

         CREATE PROCEDURE LEC_GRP_ORDRE_VIREMENT_REGULARISATION_POSITIVES
         	@TYPE_ETAT		int,		--Etat = 1 (jamais edit‚)
         	@DATE_DEBUT		datetime,
         	@DATE_FIN		datetime
         with recompile
         AS
         	BEGIN
         		CREATE TABLE #TEMP
         		(
         			ID_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE INTEGER,
         			ID_ACTIVITE INTEGER,
         			DAT_EDIT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE Datetime,
         			DAT_COMPTA_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE Datetime,
         			MNT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE decimal(18,2)
         		)
         
         		IF (@TYPE_ETAT = 1)
         			BEGIN
         				INSERT INTO #TEMP
         				SELECT DISTINCT
         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.ID_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE,
         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.ID_ACTIVITE,
         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.DAT_EDIT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE,
         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.DAT_COMPTA_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE,
         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.MNT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE
         				FROM
         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE 
         					LEFT OUTER JOIN POSTE_IMPUTATION ON VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.ID_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE = POSTE_IMPUTATION.ID_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE 
         					LEFT OUTER JOIN POSTE_VERSEMENT ON POSTE_IMPUTATION.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT = POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT
         					LEFT OUTER JOIN VERSEMENT on POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT = VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT
         					--ajout DSZ 04/06/2010
         					INNER JOIN TYPE_VERSEMENT			ON	POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT = TYPE_VERSEMENT.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT
         				WHERE       
         					--modif DSZ 04/06/2010
         					--(POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 5 OR POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 6 OR VERSEMENT.ID_STATUT_VERSEMENT = 7)
         					(TYPE_VERSEMENT.BLN_VERSEMENT_INITIAL = 0 OR VERSEMENT.ID_STATUT_VERSEMENT = 7) --regul et revers or impay‚
         					-->-- fin modif DSZ
         					AND (VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.DAT_EDIT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE IS NULL)
         					AND (VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.MNT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE >= 0)
         					
         				UPDATE VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE
         				SET VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.DAT_EDIT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE = getDate()
         				where VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.ID_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE in (select ID_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE from #TEMP)
         				
         				UPDATE #TEMP
         				SET DAT_EDIT_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE = getDate()
         			END
         		ELSE
         			BEGIN

         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.ID_VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE,
         					VIREMENT_INTERNE_COLLECTE.ID_ACTIVITE,

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[INS_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE] 
         	@ID_MODULE int,
         	@ID_DISPOSITIF int,
         	@ID_BRANCHE int,
         	@ID_ENVELOPPE int,
         	@ID_COMPTE int,
         	@ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT int,		
         	@TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT varchar(3),
         	@MNT decimal(18,2),
         	--@BLN_USE_SESSION bit, --s'il faut prendre la date de derniere session. utiliser par exemple pour cloture
         	@ID_SESSION int,
         	@DATE datetime = NULL  --s'il y a juste une date, e.g. reglement
         AS
         BEGIN
         	SET NOCOUNT ON;
         
         
         	DECLARE @dat_debut datetime
         	DECLARE @dat_fin datetime
         	DECLARE @jours_total int
         	DECLARE @id_periode int
         	DECLARE @jours_periode int
         
         
         	--ajout DSZ 31/07/09
         	if @TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT in ('C', 'EN') --cloture ou engagement net. 
         	--on met le mnt sure le periode entre la fin de la derniere session REGLE et la fin du module
         	begin
         		select  @dat_debut = CAST( floor(CAST(max(SESSION_PEC.DAT_FIN) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME), --only the date part
         				@dat_fin = CAST( floor(CAST(max(MODULE_PEC.dat_fin) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME),
         				@jours_total = datediff(d, @dat_debut, @dat_fin)
         		from MODULE_PEC
         			inner join SESSION_PEC on (SESSION_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC)
         		--ajout DSZ 18/09/09
         			inner join POSTE_COUT_REGLE on (POSTE_COUT_REGLE.id_SESSION_PEC = SESSION_PEC.id_SESSION_PEC )
         		where MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = @ID_MODULE
         		and SESSION_PEC.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         		--fin ajout DSZ
         	end	
         	--fin ajout DSZ
         	
         	if @DATE is null and @dat_debut is null -- ajout and DSZ 06/08/09
         	begin
         		if @ID_SESSION is null --que le module
         			select  @dat_debut = CAST( floor(CAST(dat_debut AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME), --only the date part
         					@dat_fin = CAST( floor(CAST(dat_fin AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME),
         					@jours_total = datediff(d, @dat_debut, @dat_fin)
         			from MODULE_PEC
         			where MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = @ID_MODULE
         		else --on prend les dates de la session
         			select  @dat_debut = CAST( floor(CAST(max(SESSION_PEC.DAT_DEBUT) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME), --only the date part
         					@dat_fin = CAST( floor(CAST(max(SESSION_PEC.DAT_FIN) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME),
         					@jours_total = datediff(d, @dat_debut, @dat_fin)
         			from SESSION_PEC
         			where ID_SESSION_PEC = @ID_SESSION
         	end
         
         
         
           -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           --------------------------------   INSERT   -----------------------------------
         
         	IF (datepart(yy,@dat_debut) = datepart(yy,@dat_fin) --seulement un periode
         		OR @DATE is not null) --une date = un periode
         	BEGIN
         		IF @DATE is null
         			select @DATE = @dat_debut
         		select @id_periode = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
         		from PERIODE
         		where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         		(@DATE >=DAT_DEB_PERIODE and @DATE <= DAT_FIN_PERIODE)
         		
         		if @id_periode is not null
         			INSERT INTO MVT_BUDGETAIRE_PERIODE

         			   (GetDate(), 
         				@MNT,
         				@id_periode,
         				@ID_DISPOSITIF,
         				@ID_BRANCHE,
         				@ID_MODULE,
         				@ID_ENVELOPPE, 
         				@ID_COMPTE, 
         				@ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT,
         				@TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT	)
         			
         	END
         	ELSE      --plus d'un periode
         	BEGIN
         		declare @mnt_calcule decimal (18,2)
         		declare @control_sum decimal (18,2)
         		set @control_sum = 0
         		DECLARE periode_cursor CURSOR FOR
         			select PERIODE.ID_PERIODE,
         			datediff(d,@dat_debut, DAT_FIN_PERIODE) as jours
         			from PERIODE
         			where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         			((@dat_debut >=DAT_DEB_PERIODE) and (@dat_debut <= DAT_FIN_PERIODE)) 
         			union
         			select PERIODE.ID_PERIODE,
         			datediff(d,DAT_DEB_PERIODE, @dat_fin)+1 as jours
         			from PERIODE
         			where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         			((@dat_fin>=DAT_DEB_PERIODE) and (@dat_fin <= DAT_FIN_PERIODE)) 
         			union
         			select PERIODE.ID_PERIODE,
         			datediff(d,DAT_DEB_PERIODE, DAT_FIN_PERIODE)+1 as jours 
         			from PERIODE
         			where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         			(DAT_DEB_PERIODE>@dat_debut and DAT_FIN_PERIODE <@dat_fin)
         
         		OPEN periode_cursor
         		FETCH NEXT FROM periode_cursor
         		INTO @id_periode, @jours_periode
         		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
         		BEGIN
         			if @id_periode is not null
         			begin
         				set @mnt_calcule = round(@MNT*(cast(@jours_periode as decimal(18,2))/ cast(@jours_total as decimal(18,2))), 2)
         				set @control_sum = @control_sum + @mnt_calcule
         				INSERT INTO MVT_BUDGETAIRE_PERIODE
         				   (DAT_CREATION,MNT_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE,ID_PERIODE,ID_DISPOSITIF,ID_BRANCHE, ID_MODULE_PEC, ID_ENVELOPPE, ID_COMPTE, ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT, TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT)
         				VALUES
         				   (GetDate(), 
         					round(@MNT*(cast(@jours_periode as decimal(18,2))/ cast(@jours_total as decimal(18,2))), 2),
         					@id_periode,
         					@ID_DISPOSITIF,
         					@ID_BRANCHE,
         					@ID_MODULE,
         					@ID_ENVELOPPE, 
         					@ID_COMPTE, 
         					@ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT,
         					@TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT)
         			end
         			FETCH NEXT FROM periode_cursor
         			INTO @id_periode, @jours_periode
         		END
         		CLOSE periode_cursor
         		DEALLOCATE periode_cursor
         
         		select @control_sum = @MNT - @control_sum
         		if (@control_sum <> 0)
         		begin
         			UPDATE MVT_BUDGETAIRE_PERIODE
         			SET MNT_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE = MNT_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE + @control_sum
         			WHERE ID_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE = @@IDENTITY
         		end
         	END
         END

         -- Author:		DSZ

         --					Dans un 2eme temps, cette PS sera supprimee 
         -- =============================================
         CREATE PROCEDURE DBO.BATCH_COMPENSATION_FPSPP_PLASTURGIE
         AS
         BEGIN
         	-- MBL 17/12/2013 : Inhibition du code de la procedure stockee
         	RETURN;
         	--drop table #tmp_etab
         	--option Plast A
         	DECLARE
         		@ID_OPTION_PLASTA INT
         	
         	SELECT
         		@ID_OPTION_PLASTA = ID_OPTION
         	FROM
         		OPTIONS
         	WHERE
         		COD_OPTION = 'PLASTA';
         	--print @id_option_plasta
         	--Lorsque les 3 conditions suivantes sont r‚unies :
         	--* le groupe d l'adh‚rent est en option Plast A
         	--* Acomptes Plan VV 2012 (somme des MNT_HT des poste imputation Plan en VV, r‚gul et reversement compris, 
         	--impay‚s et non remis en banque exclus), en excluant les montants d‚j… d‚volus au FPSPP >0
         	--* FPSPP plan restant d– (=FPSPP plan du - d‚j… vers‚) >0
         	--la liste des candidats en Plast A avec leurs montant Acomptes, D‚j… Verse FPSSPP s'il y a un montant Acompte disponible pour la compensation FPSPP
         	WITH LISTE_ETABS
         		AS (
         		SELECT
         			POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEFICIAIRE AS ID_ETAB,
         			sum(POSTE_IMPUTATION.MNT_HT) AS ACOMPTESPLANDONTFPSPP,
         			-- Montant Plan Volontaire dont FPSPP 
         			SUM(isnull(POSTE_IMPUTATION.DONT_REGLE_FPSPP, 0))  AS DEJA_REGLE_FPSPP,
         			-- Montant FPSPP total
         			R20.ID_TYPE_ASSUJETISSEMENT,
         			max(VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT) AS ID_VERSEMENT,
         			--le versement le plus recent
         			MAX(POSTE_IMPUTATION.ID_ACTIVITE ) AS ID_ACTIVITE,
         			POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_PERIODE
         		FROM
         			VERSEMENT
         			INNER JOIN POSTE_VERSEMENT
         				ON POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT=VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT
         			INNER JOIN TYPE_VERSEMENT
         				ON POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT=TYPE_VERSEMENT.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT
         			INNER JOIN POSTE_IMPUTATION
         				ON POSTE_IMPUTATION.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT=POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT
         				AND POSTE_IMPUTATION.ID_ACTIVITE IN(4, 5) --Plan
         			INNER JOIN R20
         				ON R20.ID_PERIODE=19
         				AND R20.ID_ADHERENT=VERSEMENT.ID_ADHERENT_EMETTEUR
         				AND POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_PERIODE=R20.ID_PERIODE
         			INNER JOIN ETABLISSEMENT
         				ON POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEFICIAIRE=ETABLISSEMENT.ID_ETABLISSEMENT
         				AND ETABLISSEMENT.BLN_ACTIF=1
         			INNER JOIN R20BIS
         				ON R20BIS.ID_GROUPE=ETABLISSEMENT.ID_GROUPE
         				AND R20BIS.ID_PERIODE=R20.ID_PERIODE
         				AND R20BIS.ID_OPTION=@ID_OPTION_PLASTA
         			LEFT JOIN BORDEREAU
         				ON VERSEMENT.ID_BORDEREAU=BORDEREAU.ID_BORDEREAU
         		WHERE
         			VERSEMENT.BLN_IMPAYE = 0 -- impay‚s exclus
         			AND
         			(
         				TYPE_VERSEMENT.BLN_VERSEMENT_INITIAL = 1
         				AND BORDEREAU.ID_LOT_REMISE_BANCAIRE IS NOT NULL --non remis en banque exclus
         				
         				OR --sauf si c'est une r‚gul ou un reversement, pas de remise bancaire et si c'est un reversement, qu'il soit valid‚
         				(
         					TYPE_VERSEMENT.BLN_VERSEMENT_INITIAL = 0
         					AND
         					(
         						TYPE_VERSEMENT.BLN_VERSEMENT=1

         				)
         			)

         									   AND PARAMETRE_GLOBAL.BLN_ACTIF=1

         									  AND PARAMETRE_APPEL.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT=4
         									  AND --VO

         		WHERE
         			  ACOMPTESPLANDONTFPSPP - DEJA_REGLE_FPSPP > 0.00001 -- Acompte Plan seul (dont FPSPP moins FPSPP)
         		  AND isnull(MASSE_SALARIALE_REELLE, 0) > 0
         	--select * from #tmp_etab
         	DECLARE
         		@ID_ADH INT,
         		@ID_ETAB INT,
         		@ID_ACTIVITE INT,
         		@ACOMPTEDISPO DECIMAL(18, 2),
         		@RESTANT_DU_FPSPP DECIMAL(18, 2),
         		@REGUL_FPSSP DECIMAL(18, 2)
         
         	DECLARE CURS_ADH CURSOR
         		FOR
         			SELECT
         				ID_ADHERENT,
         				ID_ETAB,
         				ACOMPTESPLANDONTFPSPP - DEJA_REGLE_FPSPP,

         	OPEN CURS_ADH

         			SET @REGUL_FPSSP = DBO.GETMIN (@ACOMPTEDISPO, @RESTANT_DU_FPSPP)

         			@ID_TIERS_EMETTEUR = NULL,
         			@ID_ETABLISSEMENT_EMETTEUR = @ID_ETAB ,

         			@DONT_FPSPP = @REGUL_FPSSP
         			-- r‚gul n‚gative 'V'			
         			SET @REGUL_FPSSP = -1 * @REGUL_FPSSP -- IMPORTANT
         			EXEC CREER_REGULARISATION_PV_PI
         			@ID_ADHERENT_EMETTEUR = @ID_ADH,
         			@ID_TIERS_EMETTEUR = NULL,

         			@MNT_VERSEMENT = @REGUL_FPSSP,
         			@ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 7,
         			@ID_PERIODE = 19,
         			@ID_ACTIVITE = @ID_ACTIVITE,
         			@DONT_FPSPP = 0
         			FETCH NEXT FROM CURS_ADH INTO @ID_ADH, @ID_ETAB, @ACOMPTEDISPO, @RESTANT_DU_FPSPP, @ID_ACTIVITE
         		END
         	CLOSE CURS_ADH
         	DEALLOCATE CURS_ADH

         -- =============================================
         -- Author:		ASD
         -- Create date: 23/06/09
         -- Description:	Inserer des donnees dans la table MVT-BUDGETAIRE_PERIODE, 
         -- pour reporting pluri-annuel du CPRO
         -- =============================================
         -- DSZ 31/07/09
         -- remplacement @BLN_USE_SESSION par @ID_SESSION
         -- refection calcul periodes (pour corriger)
         -- =============================================
         -- DSZ 05/08/09 
         -- ajout 'ENP' pour repartir sur le periode entre fin de derniere session et fin du module
         -- ajout " @dat_debut is null" pour les cas ou pas de session dans le module
         ------------------------------------------------
         -- DSZ 10/08/09
         -- ajout control_sum
         ------------------------------------------------
         -- DSZ 22/09/09
         -- ajout recherche id_enveloppe
         ------------------------------------------------
         -- DSZ 28/10/09
         -- ajout condition if @mnt_calcule <> 0
         ----------------------------------------------  
         -- OPA 31/05/2013 : 15031 : SBR - suppression du type FLOAT et REAL dans le SQL : 2- FLOAT
         -- =============================================
         
         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[INS_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE_PRO] 
         	@ID_MODULE int,
         	@ID_DISPOSITIF int,
         	@ID_BRANCHE int,
         	@ID_ENVELOPPE int,
         	@ID_COMPTE int,
         	@ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT int,		
         	@TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT varchar(3),
         	@MNT decimal(18,2),
         	--@BLN_USE_SESSION bit, --s'il faut prendre la date de derniere session. utiliser par exemple pour cloture
         	@ID_SESSION int,
         	@DATE datetime = NULL  --s'il y a juste une date, e.g. reglement
         AS
         BEGIN
         	SET NOCOUNT ON;
         
         
         	DECLARE @dat_debut datetime
         	DECLARE @dat_fin datetime
         	DECLARE @jours_total int
         	DECLARE @id_periode int
         	DECLARE @jours_periode int
         
         	--ajout DSZ 31/07/09
         	if @TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT in ('CP', 'ENP') --cloture --ENP vu avec MHBM le 4/08
         	--on met le mnt sur la periode entre la fin de la derniere session et la fin du module
         	begin
         		select  @dat_debut = CAST( floor(CAST(max(SESSION_PRO.DAT_FIN) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME), --only the date part
         				@dat_fin = CAST( floor(CAST(max(MODULE_PRO.dat_fin) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME),
         				@jours_total = datediff(d, @dat_debut, @dat_fin)
         		from MODULE_PRO
         			inner join SESSION_PRO on (SESSION_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRO = MODULE_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRO)
         		where MODULE_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRo = @ID_MODULE
         	end	
         	--fin ajout DSZ
         
         	
         	if @DATE is null and @dat_debut is null	--ajout 'and' DSZ 05/08/09
         	begin
         		if @ID_SESSION is null
         			select  @dat_debut = CAST( floor(CAST(dat_debut AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME), --only the date part
         					@dat_fin = CAST( floor(CAST(dat_fin AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME),
         					@jours_total = datediff(d, @dat_debut, @dat_fin)
         			from MODULE_PRO
         			where MODULE_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRO = @ID_MODULE
         		else
         			select  @dat_debut = CAST( floor(CAST(dat_debut AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME), --only the date part
         					@dat_fin = CAST( floor(CAST(dat_fin AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME),
         					@jours_total = datediff(d, @dat_debut, @dat_fin)
         			from SESSION_PRO
         			where ID_SESSION_PRO = @ID_SESSION
         	end
         
         --		select  @dat_debut = CAST( floor(CAST(max(SESSION_PRO.DAT_FIN) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME), --only the date part
         --				@dat_fin = CAST( floor(CAST(max(MODULE_PRO.dat_fin) AS FLOAT ))AS DATETIME),
         --				@jours_total = datediff(d, @dat_debut, @dat_fin)
         --		from MODULE_PRO
         --			inner join SESSION_PRO on (SESSION_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRO = MODULE_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRO)
         --		where MODULE_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRO = @ID_MODULE
         
         
         
           ---------------------------- ID_ ENVELOPPE ------------------------------------
         if (@ID_ENVELOPPE is null and @ID_COMPTE is null)
         begin
         	declare @id_dispo_module int
         	declare @id_periode_module int
         	declare @ID_AGENCE int
         	select 
         		@id_dispo_module = case when ID_TYPE_FORMATION = 3 then 7 --fonction tutorale = dispositif 7
         								else 5 end, 
         		@id_periode_module = MODULE_PRO.ID_PERIODE,
         		@ID_AGENCE = CONTRAT_PRO.ID_AGENCE
         	from MODULE_PRO 
         		inner join CONTRAT_PRO on (CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = MODULE_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO)
         	where ID_MODULE_PRO = @ID_MODULE
         	
         	select @ID_ENVELOPPE = id_enveloppe 
         	from enveloppe 
         	inner join type_enveloppe on (type_enveloppe.id_type_enveloppe = enveloppe.id_type_enveloppe)
         	where type_enveloppe.ID_BRANCHE = @ID_BRANCHE
         	and type_enveloppe.ID_DISPOSITIF = @id_dispo_module
         	and type_enveloppe.ID_AGENCE = @ID_AGENCE
         	and enveloppe.id_periode = @id_periode_module
         end
         
         
           -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           --------------------------------   INSERT   -----------------------------------
         
         	IF (datepart(yy,@dat_debut) = datepart(yy,@dat_fin) --seulement un periode
         		OR @DATE is not null) --une date = un periode
         	BEGIN
         		IF @DATE is null
         			select @DATE = @dat_debut
         		select @id_periode = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
         		from PERIODE
         		where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         		(@DATE >=DAT_DEB_PERIODE and @DATE <= DAT_FIN_PERIODE)
         		
         		if (@id_periode is not null and @MNT <> 0)
         			INSERT INTO MVT_BUDGETAIRE_PERIODE
         				   (DAT_CREATION,MNT_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE,ID_PERIODE,ID_DISPOSITIF,ID_BRANCHE, ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_ENVELOPPE, ID_COMPTE, ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT, TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT)
         			VALUES
         			   (GetDate(), 
         				@MNT,
         				@id_periode,
         				@ID_DISPOSITIF,
         				@ID_BRANCHE,
         				@ID_MODULE,
         				@ID_ENVELOPPE, 
         				@ID_COMPTE, 
         				@ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT,
         				@TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT	)
         			
         	END
         	ELSE      --plus d'une periode
         	BEGIN
         		declare @mnt_calcule decimal (18,2)
         		declare @control_sum decimal (18,2)
         		set @control_sum = 0
         		DECLARE periode_cursor CURSOR FOR
         			select PERIODE.ID_PERIODE,
         			datediff(d,@dat_debut, DAT_FIN_PERIODE) as jours
         			from PERIODE
         			where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         			((@dat_debut >=DAT_DEB_PERIODE) and (@dat_debut <= DAT_FIN_PERIODE)) 
         			union
         			select PERIODE.ID_PERIODE,
         			datediff(d,DAT_DEB_PERIODE, @dat_fin)+1 as jours
         			from PERIODE
         			where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         			((@dat_fin>=DAT_DEB_PERIODE) and (@dat_fin <= DAT_FIN_PERIODE)) 
         			union
         			select PERIODE.ID_PERIODE,
         			datediff(d,DAT_DEB_PERIODE, DAT_FIN_PERIODE)+1 as jours 
         			from PERIODE
         			where ID_TYPE_PERIODE = 1 and
         			(DAT_DEB_PERIODE>@dat_debut and DAT_FIN_PERIODE <@dat_fin)
         
         		OPEN periode_cursor
         		FETCH NEXT FROM periode_cursor
         		INTO @id_periode, @jours_periode
         		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
         		BEGIN
         			if @id_periode is not null
         			begin
         				set @mnt_calcule = round(@MNT*(cast(@jours_periode as float)/ cast(@jours_total as float)), 2)
         				set @control_sum = @control_sum + @mnt_calcule
         				if @mnt_calcule <> 0
         				begin
         					INSERT INTO MVT_BUDGETAIRE_PERIODE
         					   (DAT_CREATION,MNT_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE,ID_PERIODE,ID_DISPOSITIF,ID_BRANCHE, ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_ENVELOPPE, ID_COMPTE, ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT, TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT)
         					VALUES
         					   (GetDate(), 
         						@mnt_calcule,
         						@id_periode,
         						@ID_DISPOSITIF,
         						@ID_BRANCHE,
         						@ID_MODULE,
         						@ID_ENVELOPPE, 
         						@ID_COMPTE, 
         						@ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT,
         						@TYPE_ENREGISTREMENT)
         				end
         			end
         			FETCH NEXT FROM periode_cursor
         			INTO @id_periode, @jours_periode
         		END
         		CLOSE periode_cursor
         		DEALLOCATE periode_cursor
         		
         		select @control_sum = @MNT - @control_sum
         		if (@control_sum <> 0)
         		begin
         			UPDATE MVT_BUDGETAIRE_PERIODE
         			SET MNT_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE = MNT_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE + @control_sum
         			WHERE ID_MVT_BUDG_PERIODE = @@IDENTITY
         		end
         	END
         END

         -- DESCRIPTION	: SUPPR DU FILTRAGE SUR BLN_CRITERE
         --					ID_ETAT_PEC = 8 PR 
         -- =============================================
         -- AUTHOR		: DCL
         -- MODIF. DATE	: 04TH DEC 2008
         -- DESCRIPTION	: AJOUT NUM_IBAN
         -- =============================================
         -- AUTHOR		: APA
         -- CREATE DATE	: 25/01/2012
         -- DESCRIPTION	: DEFI LOT 1 - 13139 - AJOUT DU FILTRE PAR ID UTILISATEUR				
         -- =============================================
         -- HBO - 141113 - M16371: Lot 1 - Modification structure de donn‚es / proc‚dures stock‚es
         -- =============================================
         CREATE PROCEDURE LEC_GRP_REGLEMENT
         	@GENERATION_ONLY	TINYINT = NULL,
         	@MODE_CRITERE		SMALLINT = NULL,
         	@ID_UTILISATEUR		INT = NULL
         AS
         BEGIN
         	-- DONNEES TEMPORAIRES POUR @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         	SELECT
         		ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF,
         		COUNT(*) AS NB_POSTE_COUT_REGLE 
         	INTO
         		#TMP_PCR
         	FROM
         		POSTE_COUT_REGLE 
         		INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC ON MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = POSTE_COUT_REGLE.ID_MODULE_PEC
         	WHERE
         		MODULE_PEC.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF IS NOT NULL
         		AND	MODULE_PEC.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         		AND POSTE_COUT_REGLE.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         		AND	@MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         	GROUP BY
         		ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF
         
         	SELECT
         		ID_REGLEMENT, 
         		CASE
         			WHEN (COUNT(*) > 0)
         				THEN	1 
         			ELSE		0 
         		END AS IBAN_MODIFIE 
         	INTO
         		#TMP_PCR_VALID_6
         	FROM
         		POSTE_COUT_REGLE
         	WHERE
         		POSTE_COUT_REGLE.ID_ETAT_PEC = 8
         		AND	@MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         	GROUP BY
         		POSTE_COUT_REGLE.ID_REGLEMENT
         
         	-- AJOUT DCL 3/12/2008
         	DECLARE
         		@NB_REGL INT
         
         	SET
         		@NB_REGL =
         		(
         			SELECT
         				COUNT(R.ID_REGLEMENT) 
         			FROM
         				REGLEMENT R
         				INNER JOIN [TRANSACTION] T ON T.ID_TRANSACTION	= R.ID_TRANSACTION	
         			WHERE
         				(
         					(
         						@GENERATION_ONLY	= 1
         						AND	DAT_GENERATION_SEPA	IS NOT NULL
         					)	
         					OR ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         					(
         						@GENERATION_ONLY	= 0
         						AND	DAT_GENERATION_SEPA	IS NULL
         						AND R.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         						AND DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT	IS NOT NULL
         					)
         					OR ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         					(
         						@GENERATION_ONLY		IS NULL
         					)
         				) 
         				AND MNT_REGLE_TTC	<> 0
         				AND
         				(
         					@MODE_CRITERE IS NULL
         					OR ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         					(
         						@MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         						AND R.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         						AND R.BLN_EN_COURS = 1
         						AND R.DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT IS NULL
         						AND R.DAT_EDITION IS NULL
         					)
         				)
         		)
         
         		-- DONNEES GENERALES ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         		SELECT DISTINCT	
         			R.ID_REGLEMENT,
         			R.COD_REGLEMENT, 
         			R.NUM_CHEQUE,
         			R.NUM_VIREMENT, 
         			R.DAT_REGLEMENT,
         			R.DAT_EDITION, 
         			ISNULL(R.MNT_REGLE_TTC, 0)	AS MNT_REGLE_TTC,
         			ISNULL(R.MNT_REGLE_HT, 0)	AS MNT_REGLE_HT,
         			R.BLN_ACTIF,
         			R.COM_REGLEMENT, 
         			R.DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT,
         			R.DAT_COMPTA_REGLEMENT, 
         			R.DAT_MAJ_CPT_ADH,
         			R.TIME_STAMP, 
         			R.BLN_EN_COURS,
         			R.BLN_CRITERE, 
         			R.ID_TRANSACTION,
         			R.DAT_GENERATION_SEPA, 
         			R.ID_AGENCE,
         			AGENCE.LIBC_AGENCE,
         			-- AJOUT DCL 3/12/2008
         			T.NUM_IBAN					AS NUM_IBAN,
         			@NB_REGL					AS NB_REGL,
         			COALESCE(T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEF, 
         						T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_BENEF,
         						T.ID_TIERS_BENEF)	AS ID_BENEF,
         			CASE
         				WHEN (T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEF		IS NOT NULL)	THEN A2.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE
         				WHEN (T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_BENEF	IS NOT NULL)	THEN O2.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE
         				WHEN (T.ID_TIERS_BENEF				IS NOT NULL)	THEN TI.LIB_NOM
         				ELSE													 'ERREUR'
         			END							AS LIB_BENEF,
         			COALESCE(1 * T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEF/T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEF, 
         						2 * T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_BENEF/T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_BENEF,
         						3 * T.ID_TIERS_BENEF/T.ID_TIERS_BENEF)
         										AS ID_TYPE_BENEFICIAIRE,
         			CASE
         				WHEN (T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEF		IS NOT NULL)	THEN 'ADHERENT'
         				WHEN (T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_BENEF	IS NOT NULL)	THEN 'ETABLISSEMENT'
         				WHEN (T.ID_TIERS_BENEF				IS NOT NULL)	THEN 'TIERS'
         				ELSE													 'ERREUR'
         			END							AS LIB_TYPE_BENEFICIAIRE,
         			ISNULL(
         				(SELECT COUNT(*)
         				FROM POSTE_COUT_REGLE 
         				WHERE POSTE_COUT_REGLE.ID_REGLEMENT = R.ID_REGLEMENT)
         				, 0)
         										AS NOMBRE_DOSSIERS,
         			CASE
         				WHEN (T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_DEST		IS NOT NULL)	THEN A2.ID_ADHERENT
         				WHEN (T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_DEST	IS NOT NULL)	THEN O2.ID_OF
         				ELSE													 NULL
         			END							AS ID_DEST,
         			COALESCE(1 * T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_DEST / T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_DEST, 
         						2 * T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_DEST / T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_DEST)
         						 				AS ID_TYPE_DEST,
         			CASE
         				WHEN (T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_DEST IS NOT NULL AND 
         						(O.DAT_CREATION > DATEADD(MM, -3, GETDATE()) OR NB_POSTE_COUT_REGLE < 10) ) THEN 1
         				ELSE 0
         			END							AS NOUVEAUX_OF,
         			ISNULL(P6.IBAN_MODIFIE, 0)	AS IBAN_MODIFIE
         		FROM        
         			REGLEMENT R
         			LEFT  JOIN AGENCE					ON AGENCE.ID_AGENCE					= R.ID_AGENCE					AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         			INNER JOIN [TRANSACTION] T			ON T.ID_TRANSACTION					= R.ID_TRANSACTION
         			LEFT  JOIN ADHERENT A				ON A.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_PRINCIPAL		= T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_BENEF		AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         			LEFT  JOIN ORGANISME_FORMATION O	ON O.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_PRINCIPAL	= T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_BENEF	AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         			LEFT  JOIN TIERS TI					ON TI.ID_TIERS						= T.ID_TIERS_BENEF				AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         			LEFT  JOIN ADHERENT A2				ON A2.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_PRINCIPAL	= T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_DEST		AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         			LEFT  JOIN ORGANISME_FORMATION O2	ON O2.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_PRINCIPAL	= T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_DEST	AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         			LEFT  JOIN #TMP_PCR	P				ON P.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF			= T.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF_DEST	AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         			LEFT  JOIN #TMP_PCR_VALID_6 P6		ON P6.ID_REGLEMENT					= R.ID_REGLEMENT				AND @MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         		WHERE
         			(
         				(
         					@GENERATION_ONLY	= 1
         					AND	DAT_GENERATION_SEPA	IS NOT NULL
         				)	
         				OR ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         				(
         					@GENERATION_ONLY	= 0
         					AND	DAT_GENERATION_SEPA	IS NULL
         					AND R.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         					AND DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT	IS NOT NULL
         				)
         				OR ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         				(
         					@GENERATION_ONLY	IS NULL
         				)
         			)
         			AND MNT_REGLE_TTC	<> 0
         			AND
         			(
         				@MODE_CRITERE IS NULL
         				OR ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         				(
         					@MODE_CRITERE IS NOT NULL
         					AND R.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         					AND R.BLN_EN_COURS = 1
         					AND R.DAT_VALID_REGLEMENT IS NULL
         					AND R.DAT_EDITION IS NULL
         				)
         			)
         			AND
         			(
         				R.ID_UTILISATEUR = @ID_UTILISATEUR
         				OR @ID_UTILISATEUR IS NULL
         			)
         END
         Successfuly parsed: PROCEDURE [dbo].[LEC_GRP_PERIODE_SESSION] @DATE_DEBUT_SESSION DATETIME
         Successfuly parsed: PROCEDURE [dbo].[LEC_DET_MODALITE_FORMATION] @ID_MODALITE_FORMATION INTEGER

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GESTION_STAGIAIRE_PEC_CDC]
         @ID_STAGIAIRE int,
         @NUM_DOSSIER_CDC bigint,
         @DATE_ACCORD_TITULAIRE smalldatetime,
         @ID_UTILISATEUR_CREATEUR int,
         @ID_UTILISATEUR int
         
         AS  
         BEGIN
         
         DECLARE
           @COUNT INT
         
         		SELECT
         		  @COUNT = COUNT(*)
         		 FROM
         		  STAGIAIRE_PEC_CDC
         		 WHERE
         		  ID_STAGIAIRE_PEC = @ID_STAGIAIRE
         		 
         
         		IF (@COUNT > 0 )
         		BEGIN
         
         			UPDATE [STAGIAIRE_PEC_CDC]
         			SET 
         			NUM_DOSSIER_CDC = @NUM_DOSSIER_CDC ,
         			DATE_ACCORD_TITULAIRE = @DATE_ACCORD_TITULAIRE ,
         			ID_UTILISATEUR_CREATEUR = @ID_UTILISATEUR_CREATEUR,
         			ID_UTILISATEUR = @ID_UTILISATEUR,
         			DAT_MODIF = GETDATE()
         			WHERE ID_STAGIAIRE_PEC = @ID_STAGIAIRE
         			
         		END
         		ELSE
         		BEGIN
         		
         			INSERT INTO [STAGIAIRE_PEC_CDC]
         			(
         			NUM_DOSSIER_CDC,
         			ID_STAGIAIRE_PEC,
         			DATE_ACCORD_TITULAIRE  ,
         			ID_UTILISATEUR_CREATEUR ,
         			ID_UTILISATEUR ,
         			DAT_CREATION ,
         			DAT_MODIF 
         								
         			)
         			VALUES
         			(
         				@NUM_DOSSIER_CDC,
         				@ID_STAGIAIRE,
         				@DATE_ACCORD_TITULAIRE,
         				@ID_UTILISATEUR_CREATEUR,
         				@ID_UTILISATEUR,
         				GETDATE(),
         				GETDATE()
         			)
         						
         		END	
         END

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[EDT_LETTRE_REJET_OF]
         		@ID_ETABLISSEMENT int,
         		@ID_BENEFICIAIRE int,
         		@TYPE_BENEFICIAIRE int,
         		@ID_ADRESSE int,
         		@ID_CONTACT int,
         		@ID_MODULE_PEC int
         AS
         
         BEGIN
         	/****R‚cup‚ration des infos pour la partie r‚f‚rence *********************************/
         	SELECT DISTINCT ORGANISME_FORMATION.COD_OF,
         					ORGANISME_FORMATION.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE,
         					AGENCE.ID_AGENCE,
         					AGENCE.COD_POSTAL,
         					AGENCE.LIB_VILLE,
         					AGENCE.LIB_NOM_CONSEILLER,
         					AGENCE.LIB_PNM_CONSEILLER,
         					MODULE_PEC.COD_MODULE_PEC
         	INTO			#TEMP_REFERENCE
         	FROM			ORGANISME_FORMATION 
         					INNER JOIN ETABLISSEMENT_OF ON ORGANISME_FORMATION.ID_OF = ETABLISSEMENT_OF.ID_OF 
         					INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC ON MODULE_PEC.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF = ETABLISSEMENT_OF.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF
         					INNER JOIN ACTION_PEC ON MODULE_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC = ACTION_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC 
         					INNER JOIN AGENCE ON ACTION_PEC.ID_AGENCE = AGENCE.ID_AGENCE 
         	WHERE			MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = @ID_MODULE_PEC;
         
         	/****R‚cup‚ration des infos sur les modules *********************************/
         	SELECT			MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC,
         					MODULE_PEC.COD_MODULE_PEC, 
         					MODULE_PEC.LIBL_MODULE_PEC, 
         					MODULE_PEC.DAT_DEBUT,
         					MODULE_PEC.DAT_FIN,
         					MODULE_PEC.NUM_DUREE_HEURE,
         					ORGANISME_FORMATION.COD_OF,
         					ORGANISME_FORMATION.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE
         	INTO			#TEMP_MODULE
         	FROM			MODULE_PEC
         					INNER JOIN ETABLISSEMENT_OF ON MODULE_PEC.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF = ETABLISSEMENT_OF.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF
         					INNER JOIN ORGANISME_FORMATION ON ETABLISSEMENT_OF.ID_OF = ORGANISME_FORMATION.ID_OF 
         	WHERE			MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = @ID_MODULE_PEC;
         
         	/****R‚cup‚ration de la liste des adh‚rents concern‚s *********************************/
         	SELECT     		ADHERENT.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE
         	INTO			#TMP_ADHERENT
         	FROM         	ADHERENT 
         					INNER JOIN ETABLISSEMENT ON ADHERENT.ID_ADHERENT = ETABLISSEMENT.ID_ADHERENT 
         					INNER JOIN NR140 ON ETABLISSEMENT.ID_ETABLISSEMENT = NR140.ID_ETABLISSEMENT 
         					INNER JOIN ACTION_PEC ON NR140.ID_ACTION_PEC = ACTION_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC 
         					INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC ON ACTION_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC
         	WHERE			MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC = @ID_MODULE_PEC;
         
         
         /*****  Creation du flux XML *********************************************************************/
         	WITH XMLNAMESPACES (
         		DEFAULT 'LETTRE_REJET_OF'
         	)
         /**************************************************************************************************/
         
         	SELECT
         		(			
         			/**********************************************************************************************/
         			/*****************	ENTETE DE LA LETTRE *******************************************************/
         			/**********************************************************************************************/
         			SELECT	              	
         				-- R‚cup‚ration des informations sur l'agence (Emetteur)
         				dbo.GetXmlAgenceContact(ENTETE.ID_AGENCE) as EMETTEUR,
         				
         				-- R‚cup‚ration des informations sur le contact (Beneficiaire)
         				dbo.GetXmlBenefiaireContact(@ID_BENEFICIAIRE, @TYPE_BENEFICIAIRE, @ID_ADRESSE, @ID_CONTACT) as BENEFICIAIRE,
         
         				-- Informations de la partie r‚f‚rence
         				ENTETE.COD_OF,
         				ENTETE.LIB_VILLE,
         				dbo.GetFullDate(getDate()) as DATE,
         				ENTETE.COD_MODULE_PEC
         							
         			FROM #TEMP_REFERENCE AS ENTETE     
         			FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS, TYPE
         		),
         
         		(
         			/**********************************************************************************************/
         			/*****************  CORPS DE LA LETTRE *******************************************************/
         			/**********************************************************************************************/
         			SELECT	CORPS.LIBL_MODULE_PEC,
         					CONVERT(varchar(10),CORPS.DAT_DEBUT, 103) AS DAT_DEBUT,
         					CONVERT(varchar(10),CORPS.DAT_FIN, 103) AS DAT_FIN,
         					(
         						SELECT CASE 
         							WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TMP_ADHERENT) > 1 THEN 'les entreprises' 
         							ELSE 'l''entreprise'
         							END
         						
         					) AS COMPTEUR,
         					
         					(
         						SELECT	ADHERENT.LIB_RAISON_SOCIALE AS NOM_ADHERENT
         						FROM	#TMP_ADHERENT as ADHERENT
         						FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS, TYPE, ROOT('ADHERENTS')
         
         					),
         					(
         						SELECT	MOTIF_NON_IMPUTABILITE.LIBL_MOTIF_NON_IMPUTABILITE AS LIBELLE
         						FROM	MOTIF_NON_IMPUTABILITE 
         								INNER JOIN  NR204 ON MOTIF_NON_IMPUTABILITE.ID_MOTIF_NON_IMPUTABILITE = NR204.ID_MOTIF_NON_IMPUTABILITE 
         								INNER JOIN  MODULE_PEC ON NR204.ID_MODULE_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC
         						WHERE	MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC= @ID_MODULE_PEC
         						FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS, TYPE, ROOT('MOTIFS')
         					)
         			FROM	#TEMP_MODULE as CORPS
         			FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS, TYPE		
         		),
         
         		/******************* Recuperation des informations de la signature********************/
         		(
         			SELECT	SIGNATURE.LIB_PNM_CONSEILLER,
         					SIGNATURE.LIB_NOM_CONSEILLER
         			FROM
         					#TEMP_REFERENCE as SIGNATURE
         			FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS, TYPE
         		)
         		/************************************************************************************/
         
         FROM	#TEMP_MODULE as LETTRE
         	FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS
         END

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[UPD_HISTO_RETOUR_CONTRAT]
         	@STATUT_HISTO				INT	= NULL,	
         	@COD_CONTRAT_PRO			VARCHAR(10),
         	@NUM_DEPOT_DDTE				VARCHAR(50) = NULL,
         	@NUM_ENREGISTREMENT			VARCHAR(20) = NULL,
         	@DAT_DEPOT_DDTE				DATETIME = NULL,
         	@DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE	DATETIME = NULL,
         	@CODE_TYPE					INT,
         	@EXONERATION_CHARGE			TINYINT = 0,
         	@MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE	TEXT = NULL,
         	@COMMENTAIRE_COMMANDITAIRE	TEXT = NULL,
         	@ID_UTILISATEUR				INT
         AS
         
         BEGIN
         
         	DECLARE @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP INT
         	DECLARE @ID_CONTRAT_PRO INT
         	DECLARE @ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT_ADMIN INT
         
         	SELECT  @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP,
         			@ID_CONTRAT_PRO			= CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         	FROM	CONTRAT_PRO 
         			INNER JOIN HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP ON CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         	WHERE	CONTRAT_PRO.COD_CONTRAT_PRO = @COD_CONTRAT_PRO
         			/*AND HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.DAT_CREATION =
         			(
         				SELECT		MIN(DAT_CREATION) 
         				FROM		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP ST 
         				WHERE		ST.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         				GROUP BY	ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         			)*/
         			AND HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = 
         					( 
         						SELECT	MAX(HCD.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP)
         						FROM	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP HCD
         						WHERE	HCD.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         					  )
         
         	IF @DAT_DEPOT_DDTE IS NOT NULL

         			SET		DAT_DEPOT_DDTE = @DAT_DEPOT_DDTE
         			WHERE	CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         		END 
         
         	IF @NUM_ENREGISTREMENT IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN
         			UPDATE	CONTRAT_PRO
         			SET		NUM_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE = @NUM_ENREGISTREMENT
         			WHERE	CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         		END 
         
         	IF @EXONERATION_CHARGE IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN
         			UPDATE	CONTRAT_PRO
         			SET		BLN_EXONERATION_CHARGES = @EXONERATION_CHARGE
         			WHERE	CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         		END 
         
         
         
         --Determination du statut_histo selon le code type de la date d'enregistrement
         	IF @CODE_TYPE = 18
         		BEGIN
         			IF @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE IS NOT NULL
         				BEGIN
         					UPDATE	CONTRAT_PRO
         					SET		CONTRAT_PRO.DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE = @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE
         					WHERE		CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         
         					UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         					SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE = @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE			
         					WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         
         					UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         					SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.STATUT_HISTO = 30
         					WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         
         					
         				END
         		END
         
         	ELSE IF @CODE_TYPE = 19
         		BEGIN
         			IF @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE IS NOT NULL
         				BEGIN
         					UPDATE	CONTRAT_PRO
         					SET		CONTRAT_PRO.DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE = @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE
         					WHERE		CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         
         					UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         					SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE = @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE			
         					WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         				END
         
         			SET  @STATUT_HISTO = 100
         			
         		END
         	ELSE IF @CODE_TYPE = 20
         		BEGIN
         			SET  @STATUT_HISTO = 50
         		END
         
         	
         	--Mise a jour de la table HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP pour l'envoi et le contrat concern‚
         	IF	@STATUT_HISTO IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.STATUT_HISTO = @STATUT_HISTO			
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         		END
         
         	IF (@CODE_TYPE = 4) AND (@STATUT_HISTO IS NULL)
         		BEGIN
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.STATUT_HISTO = 30			
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         		END
         
         	
         
         	--	NUM_DEPOT_DDTE
         	IF	@NUM_DEPOT_DDTE IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.NUM_DEPOT_DDTE = @NUM_DEPOT_DDTE
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         		END
         
         	--	NUM_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE
         	IF	@NUM_ENREGISTREMENT IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.NUM_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE = @NUM_ENREGISTREMENT
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         
         			UPDATE	CONTRAT_PRO
         			SET		NUM_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE = @NUM_ENREGISTREMENT
         			WHERE	CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         
         			
         
         		END
         
         	--	MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE
         	IF	@MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE = @MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         		END
         
         	--	COMMENTAIRE_COMMANDITAIRE
         	IF	@COMMENTAIRE_COMMANDITAIRE IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.COMMENTAIRE_COMMANDITAIRE = @COMMENTAIRE_COMMANDITAIRE
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         		END
         
         	--	MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE
         	IF	@MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE = @MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         		END
         
         	--	BLN_EXONERATION_CHARGES
         	IF	@EXONERATION_CHARGE  = 1
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.BLN_EXONERATION_CHARGES = @EXONERATION_CHARGE
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         		END
         
         	--	@DAT_DEPOT_DDTE
         	IF	@DAT_DEPOT_DDTE IS NOT NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.DAT_DEPOT_DDTE = @DAT_DEPOT_DDTE
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP

         			SET		CONTRAT_PRO.DAT_DEPOT_DDTE = @DAT_DEPOT_DDTE
         			WHERE	CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         
         		END
         
         	--	@CODE_TYPE = 4 (Date de depot = date d'enregistrement quand codetype =4)
         	IF	@CODE_TYPE = 4 and @DAT_DEPOT_DDTE IS NULL
         		BEGIN	
         			UPDATE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         			SET		HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.DAT_DEPOT_DDTE = @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE
         			WHERE	HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP.ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP = @ID_HISTO_CONTRAT_DGEFP
         
         			UPDATE	CONTRAT_PRO
         			SET		CONTRAT_PRO.DAT_DEPOT_DDTE = @DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE
         			WHERE	CONTRAT_PRO.ID_CONTRAT_PRO = @ID_CONTRAT_PRO
         
         		END
         
         
         	IF	@EXONERATION_CHARGE  = 0
         		BEGIN	
         			--Evenement administratif
         			SELECT  @ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT_ADMIN = ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT_ADMIN
         			FROM	TYPE_EVENEMENT_ADMIN
         			WHERE	COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT_ADMIN = 'REFUDDTE'
         
         			--RMA 20090316 Cas o— motifs est NULL : LIBL_EVENEMENT_ADMIN Non null
         			IF @MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE IS NULL BEGIN SET @MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE = '' END
         			--
         
         			EXEC INS_EVENEMENT_ADMIN @MOTIF_CONTROL_CONFORMITE,@ID_UTILISATEUR,@ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT_ADMIN,@ID_CONTRAT_PRO,1,@DAT_ENREGISTREMENT_DDTE
         	END
         	
         
         END
