         -- MBL 06/05/2014 : Modification Detection du sous type de cout sur les evenements de reglements
         -- =============================================
         -- MB 16/10/2014 : Gestion de la cloture Module et de la decloture dans le calcul de la section '3 - RECREDITE ANNEE N'
         -- =============================================
         -- HBO - 2014-12-30 -~#662 : Suppression de LIBC_PUBLIC_FAF
         -- =============================================
         BEGIN
          DECLARE
           @LIB_GROUPE VARCHAR(100),
           @NUM_ANNEE VARCHAR(4)
         
          SELECT
           @LIB_GROUPE = LIB_GROUPE + ' (' + COD_GROUPE + ')'
          FROM
           GROUPE
          WHERE
           ID_GROUPE = @ID_GROUPE  
         
          SET
           @NUM_ANNEE = YEAR([dbo].[GetShortDate](@DAT_DEBUT))  
           
           
          -- #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE : Liste de tous les mouvements budgetaires associes au groupe sur la periode
          SELECT
           MVT.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           MVT.ID_PERIODE_FISC,
           TM.LIBC_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           MVT.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           MVT.ID_EVENEMENT,
           MVT.ID_COMPTE,
           MVT.P_E_R,
           VERSEMENT.DAT_SAISIE AS DAT_SAISIE_VERSEMENT,
           VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT,
           PERIODE.NUM_ANNEE AS ANNEE_IMPUT,
           PS.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT,
           PS.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT,
           TV.COD_TYPE_VERSEMENT,
           TE.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT,
           TE.COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT,
           MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE,
           MVT.ID_MODULE_PEC,
           MVT.ID_CONTRAT_PRO,
           -- MBL 06/05/2014 : Modification Detection du sous type de cout sur les evenements de reglements
           ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = ISNULL(PCR.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT, PCE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT)
          INTO
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          FROM
           MVT_BUDGETAIRE MVT
           INNER JOIN EVENEMENT
            ON MVT.ID_EVENEMENT  = EVENEMENT.ID_EVENEMENT
           INNER JOIN TYPE_EVENEMENT TE
            ON TE.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT = EVENEMENT.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT
           INNER JOIN TYPE_MOUVEMENT TM
            ON TM.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
           LEFT JOIN VERSEMENT
            ON VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT = EVENEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT
           LEFT JOIN POSTE_VERSEMENT PS
            ON PS.ID_VERSEMENT   = VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT
             AND MVT.ID_PERIODE_FISC=ps.ID_PERIODE
           LEFT JOIN PERIODE
            ON PERIODE.ID_PERIODE = PS.ID_PERIODE
           LEFT JOIN TYPE_VERSEMENT TV
            ON TV.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT = PS.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT
           LEFT JOIN ENVELOPPE
            ON MVT.ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE
           LEFT JOIN POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE PCE
            ON PCE.ID_POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE = EVENEMENT.ID_POSTE_COUT_ENGAGE
           -- MBL 06/05/2014 : Modification Detection du sous type de cout sur les evenements de reglements
           LEFT JOIN POSTE_COUT_REGLE PCR
            ON PCR.ID_POSTE_COUT_REGLE = EVENEMENT.ID_POSTE_COUT_REGLE
          WHERE
           MVT.ID_GROUPE = @ID_GROUPE
           AND MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE >= [dbo].[GetShortDate](@DAT_DEBUT)
           AND MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= [dbo].[GetShortDate](@DAT_FIN)
           AND ABS(MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE ) > 0
         
          ------------------ #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE  ------------------  
          -- #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE : Liste de tous les mouvements budgetaires associes au groupe imputant le compte groupe sur la periode
          SELECT
           MVT.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           MVT.ID_ADHERENT,
           MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           TYPE_MOUVEMENT.LIBC_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           MVT.ID_EVENEMENT,
           MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           LIBL_TYPE_FINANCEMENT,
           PERIODE.NUM_ANNEE,
           TE.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT,
           MNT_MVT_GROUPE = MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE SENS WHEN 'C' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END),
           MNT_DEBIT = MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           MNT_CREDIT = MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
           LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           LIBL_PERIODE = 'Ann‚e Rbt. P10+ ' + CAST(NUM_ANNEE AS VARCHAR),
           P_E_R,
           TAG = CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))
          INTO
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          FROM
           MVT_BUDGETAIRE MVT
           INNER JOIN EVENEMENT
            ON MVT.ID_EVENEMENT = EVENEMENT.ID_EVENEMENT
           INNER JOIN COMPTE
            ON MVT.ID_COMPTE = COMPTE.ID_COMPTE
           INNER JOIN TYPE_COMPTE
            ON COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE = TYPE_COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE
           INNER JOIN TYPE_MOUVEMENT
            ON MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
           INNER JOIN PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE
            ON PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
             AND PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE = TYPE_COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE
           INNER JOIN PERIODE
            ON COMPTE.ID_PERIODE = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
           INNER JOIN TYPE_FINANCEMENT
            ON COMPTE.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT = TYPE_FINANCEMENT.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT
           INNER JOIN TYPE_EVENEMENT TE
            ON TE.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT = EVENEMENT.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT
          WHERE
           COMPTE.ID_GROUPE = @ID_GROUPE
           AND COMPTE.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT = 1   -- On ne prend en compte que le compte courant pas les fonds MUT
           AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE >= @DAT_DEBUT
           AND DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_FIN
           AND MVT.ID_COMPTE IS NOT NULL
           AND ABS(MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE ) > 0
          ORDER BY
           COMPTE.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT,
           NUM_ANNEE,
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           P_E_R
          
          -------------------- 0.Report du solde d'engagement disponible initial --------------------------------
          DECLARE
           @SOLDE_ENGAGEMENT_INITIAL  DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_RELIQUAT_PREVISIONNEL_INITIAL DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_I_P DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_I_E DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_I_R DECIMAL(18,2),
           @ID_CPT INT
          
          SELECT
           MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE = MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE PB.SENS WHEN 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END),
           MNT_DEBIT  = MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE PB.SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           MNT_CREDIT = MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE PB.SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           PER = MVT.P_E_R,
           COMPTE.ID_COMPTE
          INTO
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL
          FROM
           COMPTE,
           MVT_BUDGETAIRE MVT,
           PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE PB,
           TYPE_COMPTE,
           PERIODE,
           TYPE_MOUVEMENT  
          WHERE
           @ID_GROUPE IS NOT NULL
           AND COMPTE.ID_GROUPE = @ID_GROUPE
           AND MVT.ID_COMPTE = COMPTE.ID_COMPTE
           AND COMPTE.ID_PERIODE = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
           AND COMPTE.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT    = 1   -- On ne prend en compte que le compte courant pas les fonds MUT
           AND MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE < @DAT_DEBUT
           AND TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
           AND PB.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT  = MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
           AND COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE = TYPE_COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE
           AND PB.ID_TYPE_COMPTE = TYPE_COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE
         
          ----- GETTING THE AMOUNT INITIAL  
          SELECT
           @MNT_I_P = ISNULL(SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE)  , 0)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL
          WHERE
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE < @DAT_DEBUT AND PER = 'P'
          
          SET
           @MNT_RELIQUAT_PREVISIONNEL_INITIAL = @MNT_I_P
          
          SELECT
           @MNT_I_E = ISNULL(SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE) , 0)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL
          WHERE
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE < @DAT_DEBUT AND PER = 'E'
          
          SELECT
           @MNT_I_R = ISNULL(SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE) , 0)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL
          WHERE
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE < @DAT_DEBUT AND PER = 'R'
          
          SET
           @MNT_I_E = @MNT_I_E + @MNT_I_R
          
          SET
           @MNT_I_P = @MNT_I_P + @MNT_I_E
          
          SELECT
           @SOLDE_ENGAGEMENT_INITIAL = @MNT_I_E
          
          ---------------------------- FIN 0.Report du solde disponible ---------------------------------------------------------
          ----------------- 1. TOUTE LES VERSEMENT VOLONTAIRE  DE 'Date de d‚but' … 'Date de fin' -------------------------------
          -- On recupere dans #TMP_VERSEMENT1 tous les versements vers‚s sur l'activit‚ P10+ (Montant Vers‚ HT)  sur l'enveloppe de collecte
          -- Correspond au montant HT du versement
          SELECT
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.LIBC_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           sum(#TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE) as MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           --#TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.DAT_SAISIE_VERSEMENT,
           VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ANNEE_IMPUT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE .COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT,
           VERSEMENT.DAT_ENCAISSEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.P_E_R,
           MODE_VERSEMENT.LIBL_MODE_VERSEMENT
          INTO
           #TMP_VERSEMENT1
          FROM
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           INNER JOIN ENVELOPPE
            ON #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE
           INNER JOIN TYPE_ENVELOPPE
            ON TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE
             AND TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_ACTIVITE NOT IN (select id_activite from GET_IDS_ACTIVITE_BY_COD_TYPE_ACTIVITE('PROF')) -- 14822
           INNER JOIN VERSEMENT
            ON #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_VERSEMENT = VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT
           INNER JOIN POSTE_VERSEMENT
            ON #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT = POSTE_VERSEMENT .ID_POSTE_VERSEMENT
           INNER JOIN MODE_VERSEMENT
            ON VERSEMENT.ID_MODE_VERSEMENT = MODE_VERSEMENT.ID_MODE_VERSEMENT
          WHERE
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.COD_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 'VOLONT' -- Versement Volontaire
           AND  #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE LIKE '%volontaire%'
           AND  #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_PERIODE_FISC=POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_PERIODE
           AND  TYPE_ENVELOPPE.BLN_COLLECTE = 1
           AND  VERSEMENT.BLN_ACTIF   = 1
          GROUP BY
           VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT,
           POSTE_VERSEMENT.ID_PERIODE,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.LIBC_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.DAT_SAISIE_VERSEMENT,
           VERSEMENT.ID_VERSEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ANNEE_IMPUT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE .COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT,
           VERSEMENT.DAT_ENCAISSEMENT,
           #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.P_E_R,
           MODE_VERSEMENT.LIBL_MODE_VERSEMENT
          
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '1 -VERSEMENT VOLONTAIRE'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           COD_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 'VOLONT' -- Versement Volontaire
           AND #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE LIKE '%volontaire%' -- Versement Volontaire
           AND TAG IS NULL
          
          -- On recupere dans #TMP_VERSEMENT2 tous les versements vers‚s pour l'activit‚ P10+ (Montant Vers‚ HT) sur le compte adherent
          SELECT DISTINCT
           C.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           C.LIBC_TYPE_MOUVEMENT,
           T.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           T.DAT_SAISIE_VERSEMENT,
           T.ID_VERSEMENT,
           T.ANNEE_IMPUT,
           T.ID_TYPE_VERSEMENT,
           T.P_E_R
          INTO
           #TMP_VERSEMENT2
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE C
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE T
            ON C.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = T.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           TAG = '1 -VERSEMENT VOLONTAIRE'
           AND T.COD_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 'VOLONT' -- Versement Volontaire
           AND T.ID_COMPTE IS NOT NULL
           -- 15199 : HBO - 17/05/13 - Ancien traitement
           --SELECT  distinct (CASE WHEN A.ID_VERSEMENT IS NULL
           --   THEN 'VIREMENT - ' + CAST(B.ID_VERSEMENT  AS VARCHAR(15))
           --   ELSE 'VIREMENT - ' + CAST(A.ID_VERSEMENT  AS VARCHAR(15))END) AS LIB_VERSEMENT,  
          SELECT
           UPPER (A.LIBL_MODE_VERSEMENT) + ' - ' + CAST(A.ID_VERSEMENT  AS VARCHAR(15)) AS LIB_VERSEMENT,
           A.ANNEE_IMPUT,
           CASE A.P_E_R
            WHEN  'P'
             THEN A.DAT_ENCAISSEMENT
            ELSE  NULL
           END AS DAT_PREV,
           CASE A.P_E_R
            WHEN  'P'
             THEN A.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ELSE  0.00
           END AS MNT_PREV,
           CASE A.P_E_R
            WHEN  'P'
             THEN NULL
            ELSE  A.DAT_SAISIE_VERSEMENT
           END AS DAT_SAISIE_VERSEMENT,
           CASE A.P_E_R
            WHEN  'P'
             THEN 0.00
            ELSE  A.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           END AS MNT_VERSE_HT,
           CASE A.P_E_R
            WHEN  'P'
             THEN 0.00
            ELSE  B.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           END AS MNT_MOBILISABLE_HT
          INTO
           #FINAL_VERSEMENT_PART1
          FROM
           #TMP_VERSEMENT1 A
           INNER JOIN #TMP_VERSEMENT2 B
            ON A.ID_VERSEMENT = B.ID_VERSEMENT
             AND A.ANNEE_IMPUT = B.ANNEE_IMPUT
             AND A.P_E_R = B.P_E_R
          WHERE
           (
            A.DAT_ENCAISSEMENT IS NOT NULL
            AND A.P_E_R = 'P'
           )
           OR A.P_E_R = 'R'
          
          IF (@BLN_DEBUG = 1)
          BEGIN
           --select * from #TMP_VERSEMENT1
           --select * from #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE C
           --INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE   T ON C .ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = T .ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           --WHERE TAG =  '1 -VERSEMENT VOLONTAIRE'
           --AND  T.COD_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 'VOLONT' -- Versement Volontaire
           --AND  T.ID_COMPTE IS NOT NULL
           ----select * from #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLe
           --select * from #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE where id_versement=107204
           --select * from #TMP_VERSEMENT2
           --select * from #FINAL_VERSEMENT_PART1
           SELECT
            '#TMP_VERSEMENT1',
            *
           FROM
            #TMP_VERSEMENT1 A
           WHERE
            (
             A.DAT_ENCAISSEMENT IS NOT NULL
             AND A.P_E_R = 'P'
            )
            OR A.P_E_R = 'R'
            AND ID_VERSEMENT = 86043
           
           SELECT
            '#TMP_VERSEMENT2',
            *
           FROM
            #TMP_VERSEMENT2
           WHERE
            ID_VERSEMENT = 86043
           
           --select * from #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE order by DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE desc
           SELECT
            '#FINAL_VERSEMENT_PART1',
            *
           FROM
            #FINAL_VERSEMENT_PART1
           WHERE
            LIB_VERSEMENT LIKE '%86043%'
          END
         
          ---------------------------- FIN DE PARTI 1. VERSEMENT VOLONTAIRES -------------------------------------------------------
          ---------------------------- DEBUT DE 2. RELIQUATS PLAN DE FORMATION -----------------------------------------------------
          DECLARE
           @RELIQUATS_PLAN_FORMATION_PART2 DECIMAL(18,2),
           @RELIQUATS_PLAN_FORMATION_DEBUT DECIMAL(18,2)
          
          -- 2 RELIQUAT PLAN DE FORMATION  
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '2 RELIQUAT PLAN DE FORMATION'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           COD_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 'OBLIG'  -- OBLIGATOIRE
           AND #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R = 'R'
           AND TAG IS NULL
          
          SELECT
           @RELIQUATS_PLAN_FORMATION_PART2 = SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '2 RELIQUAT PLAN DE FORMATION'
          
          IF (@BLN_DEBUG = 1)
          BEGIN
           SELECT
            '2 RELIQUAT PLAN DE FORMATION',
            *
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           WHERE
            TAG = '2 RELIQUAT PLAN DE FORMATION'
          END
          
          ---------------------------- FIN DE 2. RELIQATS PLAN DE FORMATION ---------------------------------------------------------
          ---------------------------- DEBUT DE 3. TOTAL DES FONDS RECREDITES -------------------------------------------------------
          DECLARE
           @TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES_PART31 DECIMAL(18,2),
           @TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES_PART32 DECIMAL(18,2),
           @TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES DECIMAL(18,2)
          
          -- 3.1 .Dont Montant Desengage sur les dossiers annee N suite a cloture
          /* MB MODIF du 16/10/2014
          -- Gestion de la cloture Module et de la decloture
          */
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '3 - RECREDITE ANNEE N'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R = 'E'
           AND NUM_ANNEE >= @NUM_ANNEE
           AND TAG IS NULL
           AND
           (
            EXISTS
            (
             SELECT
              ID_MODULE_PEC,
              SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE)
             FROM
              #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE TMP_E
             WHERE
              TMP_E.ID_MODULE_PEC = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC
              AND TMP_E.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
              AND TMP_E.COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ('CLOTACT', 'CLOMOPEC', 'ANCLOPEC') -- Cloture Action, Cloture Module et Annulation Cloture
             GROUP BY
              ID_MODULE_PEC
             HAVING
              CAST(ABS(SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) > 0
            )
           )
          /* Fin MB MODIF du 16/10/2014 */
          
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '3 - RECREDITE ANNEE N'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R IN ('E', 'R')
           AND #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC IS NOT NULL
           AND NUM_ANNEE >= @NUM_ANNEE
           AND TAG IS NULL
           AND
           (
            NOT EXISTS
            (
             SELECT 1
             FROM
              #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE TMP_E
             WHERE
              TMP_E.ID_MODULE_PEC = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC
              AND TMP_E.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
              AND TMP_E.COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ('ENGAGMT')
              AND TMP_E.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            )
           )
           AND COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT NOT IN ('ENGAGMT', 'REGLEMT' , 'REGCOURT')
           AND
           (
            NOT EXISTS
            (
             SELECT 1
             FROM
              #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE TMP_E
             WHERE
              TMP_E.ID_MODULE_PEC = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC
              AND TMP_E.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
              AND LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE LIKE 'REP%'  -- Reprise
            )
           )
         
          IF (@BLN_DEBUG = 1)
          BEGIN
           SELECT
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.TAG,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.NUM_ANNEE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.MNT_MVT_GROUPE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R,
            COD_MODULE_PEC
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
            INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
             ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC
             ON #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC
            --WHERE COD_MODULE_PEC like '000608 01/2009'
           ORDER BY
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.NUM_ANNEE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          END
         
          SELECT
           @TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES_PART31 = SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '3 - RECREDITE ANNEE N'
          
          -- 3.2 .Dont Montant Desengage ou Regle sur les dossiers ANTERIEURES et Non engage sur la periode
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '3 - RECREDITE ANNEES ANTERIEURES'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R IN ('E', 'R')
           AND #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC IS NOT NULL
           AND NUM_ANNEE < @NUM_ANNEE
           AND TAG IS NULL
           AND
           (
            NOT EXISTS
            (
             SELECT 1
             FROM
              #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE TMP_E
             WHERE
              TMP_E.ID_MODULE_PEC = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC
              AND TMP_E.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
              AND TMP_E.COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ('ENGAGMT')
              AND TMP_E.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE < #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            )
           )
           AND COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT NOT IN ('ENGAGMT', 'REGLEMT' , 'REGCOURT')
           AND
           (
            NOT EXISTS
            (
             SELECT 1
             FROM
              #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE TMP_E
             WHERE
              TMP_E.ID_MODULE_PEC = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC
              AND TMP_E.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
              AND LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE LIKE 'REP%'  -- Reprise
            )
           )
         
          SELECT
           @TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES_PART32 = SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '3 - RECREDITE ANNEES ANTERIEURES'
          
          SELECT
           @TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES = ISNULL(@TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES_PART31,0) + ISNULL(@TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES_PART32,0)
         
          ---------------------------- FIN DE 3. TOTAL DES FONDS RECREDITES -------------------------------------------
          ---------------------------- DEBUT DE 5. ENGAGEMENTS---------------------------------------------------------
          DECLARE
           @MNT_ENGAGE_ET_REGLE DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_ENGAGE_ET_NON_REGLE DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_ENGAGE_COMPL DECIMAL(18,2)
           
          --5.1 Formation engages et reglees  
          -- Part 5.1
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '5.1 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET REGLEES'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           ID_MODULE_PEC IS NOT NULL
           AND COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ('REGLEMT' , 'REGCOURT')
           AND #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R = 'R'
           AND TAG IS NULL
           AND
           (
            EXISTS
            (
             SELECT 1
             FROM
              #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE TMP_E
             WHERE
              TMP_E.ID_MODULE_PEC = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC
              AND TMP_E.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
              AND
              (
               TMP_E.COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN  ('ENGAGMT')
               OR LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE LIKE 'REP%'  -- Reprise
              )
            )
           )
         
          SELECT
           @MNT_ENGAGE_ET_REGLE = - SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '5.1 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET REGLEES'
          
          SELECT
           NUM_ANNEE,
           MNT_REGLE = -SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          INTO
           #FOR_ENGAGE_ET_REGLE
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '5.1 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET REGLEES'
          GROUP BY
           NUM_ANNEE
          
          -- 5.2 Formation engage et non reglees
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '5.2 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET NON REGLEES'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           ID_MODULE_PEC IS NOT NULL
           AND #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R = 'E'
           AND
           (
            EXISTS
            (
             SELECT 1
             FROM
              #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE TMP_E
             WHERE
              TMP_E.ID_MODULE_PEC = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC
              AND TMP_E.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
              AND
              (
               TMP_E.COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ('ENGAGMT')
               OR LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE LIKE 'REP%'  -- Reprise 
              )
            )
           )
           AND TAG IS NULL
          
          SELECT
           @MNT_ENGAGE_ET_NON_REGLE = -SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '5.2 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET NON REGLEES'
          
          SELECT
           NUM_ANNEE,
           MNT_REGLE = -SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          INTO
           #FOR_ENGAGE_ET_NON_REGLE
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '5.2 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET NON REGLEES'
          GROUP BY
           NUM_ANNEE
          
          --5.3 CALCUL DES REGLEMENTS COMPLEMENTAIRES
          -- M‚thodologie:
          -- Pour un module et un sous type de cout, si pour les evenements de reglements,
          -- la somme des mvt budg de rŠglement (P_E_R = 'R') > la somme des mvt budg d'engagement (P_E_R = 'E')
          -- sur des engagements non r‚alis‚es sur la periode
          -- alors il y a engagement compl‚mentaire
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          SET
           TAG = '5.3 REGLEMENTS COMPLEMENTAIRES'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           ID_MODULE_PEC IS NOT NULL
           AND COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ('REGLEMT' , 'REGCOURT')
           AND #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R IN ('E', 'R')
           AND TAG IS NULL
          
          SET
           @MNT_ENGAGE_COMPL = 0
          
          SELECT
           @MNT_ENGAGE_COMPL = -SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '5.3 REGLEMENTS COMPLEMENTAIRES'
          
          IF (@BLN_DEBUG = 1)
          BEGIN
           SELECT
            COD_MODULE_PEC,
            ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT,
            NUM_ANNEE,
            DAT_CLOTURE,
            MNT_ENGAGE,
            MNT_REGLE,
            MNT_SOLDE = MNT_REGLE - MNT_ENGAGE
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_REGLE_COMPLEMENTAIRE
            INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC
             ON #TMP_MVT_REGLE_COMPLEMENTAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC
            INNER JOIN ACTION_PEC
             ON MODULE_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC = ACTION_PEC.ID_ACTION_PEC
          END
          
          ---------------------------- FIN  DE 5. ENGAGEMENTS---------------------------------------------------------
          ----------------------------  DEBUT DE 6. COMPTE PREVISIONNEL ----------------------------------------------
          DECLARE
           @MNT_VERSEMENT_PREV DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_FORMATION_PREV DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_SOLD_PREV  DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_VERSEMENT_OBLIG_DIFFERE DECIMAL(18,2)
         
          -- 6.0     Reliquat Consommation pr‚visionnelle 
          -- @MNT_RELIQUAT_PREVISIONNEL_INITIAL
         
          -- 6.1.1 Versements volontaires previsionnels
          SELECT
           @MNT_VERSEMENT_PREV = SUM(MNT_PREV) 
          FROM
           #FINAL_VERSEMENT_PART1
         
          -- 6.1.2 Versements obligatoires differes
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE 
          SET
           TAG = '6 VERSEMENT OBLIGATOIRE DIFFERE'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE 
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R = 'P'
           AND COD_TYPE_VERSEMENT = 'OBLIG'
           AND TAG IS NULL
          
          SELECT
           @MNT_VERSEMENT_OBLIG_DIFFERE = SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '6 VERSEMENT OBLIGATOIRE DIFFERE'
          
          -- 6.2 Formation previsionnel
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE 
          SET
           TAG = '6 FORMATION PREVISIONNEL'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE 
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          WHERE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R = 'P'
           AND ID_MODULE_PEC IS NOT NULL
           AND TAG IS NULL
          
          SELECT
           @MNT_FORMATION_PREV = SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE)
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '6 FORMATION PREVISIONNEL'
          
          SET
           @MNT_SOLD_PREV = ISNULL(@MNT_RELIQUAT_PREVISIONNEL_INITIAL, 0)
           + ISNULL(@MNT_VERSEMENT_PREV,0)
           + ISNULL(@MNT_VERSEMENT_OBLIG_DIFFERE, 0)
           + ISNULL(@MNT_FORMATION_PREV,0)
          
          ----------------------------  FIN DE 6. COMPTE PREVISIONNEL ----------------------------------------------
          ---------------------------- DEBUT DE 4. REGULARISATION (VIREMENTS, RESTITUTIONS,..) ---------------------
          -- On prend tous les mouvements de reglement ou d'engagement imput‚s sur le compte avec TAG vierge
          UPDATE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE 
          SET
           TAG = '4 REGUL'
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE 
           INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE 
          WHERE
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R IN ('E', 'R')
           AND TAG IS NULL 
         
          CREATE TABLE #REGULARISATION_PART4
          (
           DAT_REGUL DATETIME NULL,
           LIB_REGULARISATION VARCHAR(70),
           MNT_REGULARISATION DECIMAL(18,2)
          )
         
          INSERT INTO
           #REGULARISATION_PART4
          SELECT
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE AS DAT_REGUL,
           LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE + '(' + CAST(NUM_ANNEE AS VARCHAR(4) ) + ')' AS LIB_REGULARISATION,
           ISNULL(MNT_MVT_GROUPE,0) AS MNT_REGULARISATION
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '4 REGUL'
           AND #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT NOT IN (32,33)
          ORDER BY
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           LIBC_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
         
          --* Regrouper par p‚riode, parmi les lignes de d‚tail du tableau 4-, celles qui sont associ‚es … des ‚venements de type_evenement = 32 et 33 en utilisant les titres :
          --   > "Fonds prescrits <code_periode>" pour : les mvts_budg associ‚s … des ‚venements de type_evenement = 33 de la p‚riode
          --   > "Fonds Mutualis‚s suppl‚mentaires <code_periode>" pour : les mvts_budg associ‚s … des ‚venements de type_evenement = 32 de la p‚riode
          INSERT INTO #REGULARISATION_PART4
          (
           LIB_REGULARISATION,
           MNT_REGULARISATION
          )
          SELECT
           CASE ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT
            WHEN  33
             THEN 'Fonds prescrits '
            ELSE  'Fonds Mutualis‚s suppl‚mentaires '
           END
           + CAST(NUM_ANNEE AS VARCHAR(4)) AS LIB_REGULARISATION,
           SUM(MNT_MVT_GROUPE) AS MNT_REGULARISATION
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
          WHERE
           TAG = '4 REGUL'
           AND #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN (32,33)
          GROUP BY
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT,
           #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.NUM_ANNEE
          
          ---------------------------- FIN DE 4. REGULARISATION (VIREMENTS, RESTITUTIONS,..) ---------------------------------------------------------  
          IF (@BLN_DEBUG = 1)
          BEGIN
           SELECT
            TAG,
            LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            P_E_R,
            MNT_MVT_GROUPE,
            *
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
           WHERE
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R IN ('E', 'R')
           ORDER BY
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.NUM_ANNEE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           
           SELECT
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.TAG,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.NUM_ANNEE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.MNT_MVT_GROUPE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R,
            COD_MODULE_PEC
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
            INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
             ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC
             ON #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC
           WHERE
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R IN ('E', 'R')
           ORDER BY
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.NUM_ANNEE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
          END
         
          IF (@BLN_DEBUG = 1)
          BEGIN
           SELECT
            TAG,
            ID_MODULE_PEC,
            ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            MNT_MVT_GROUPE
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
            INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
             ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           WHERE
            TAG = '5.1 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET REGLEES'
            AND NUM_ANNEE = 2009
           ORDER BY
            2,
            3
           
           SELECT
            TAG,
            ID_MODULE_PEC,
            ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            MNT_MVT_GROUPE
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
            INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
             ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           WHERE
            TAG = '5.2 FORMATIONS ENGAGEES ET NON REGLEES'
            AND NUM_ANNEE = 2009
           ORDER BY
            2,
            3
          END
         
          IF (@BLN_DEBUG = 2)
          BEGIN
           SELECT
            TAG,
            ID_MODULE_PEC,
            ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.LIBL_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            MNT_MVT_GROUPE
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
            INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
             ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           WHERE
            NUM_ANNEE = 2009
           ORDER BY
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
           
           SELECT
            COD_MODULE_PEC,
            ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT,
            TAG,
            SUM(CAST(MNT_MVT_GROUPE AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
            MIN(#TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE),
            MAX(#TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE)
           FROM
            #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE
            INNER JOIN #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
             ON #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MVT_BUDGETAIRE
            INNER JOIN MODULE_PEC
             ON #TOUTE_MVT_BUDGETAIRE.ID_MODULE_PEC = MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC
           WHERE
            NUM_ANNEE = 2009
            --AND (--TAG LIKE '5%' OR  TAG LIKE '6%')
            AND #TMP_MVT_BUD_ENG_ET_REGLE.P_E_R IN ('E', 'R')
           GROUP BY
            TAG,
            COD_MODULE_PEC,
            ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT
           HAVING
            ABS(SUM(CAST(MNT_MVT_GROUPE AS DECIMAL(18,2)))) > 0
           ORDER BY
            1,
            2,
            3
          END
         
          ------------------ Total Mobilisable plan (0+1+2+3+4)  
          DECLARE
           @TOTAL_MOB_PLAN DECIMAL(18,2)
          
          SELECT
           @TOTAL_MOB_PLAN =
            ISNULL(@SOLDE_ENGAGEMENT_INITIAL,0)
            + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(MNT_MOBILISABLE_HT) FROM #FINAL_VERSEMENT_PART1),0)
            + ISNULL((@RELIQUATS_PLAN_FORMATION_PART2),0)
            + ISNULL(@TOTAL_FONDS_RECREDITES,0)
            + ISNULL((SELECT  SUM(MNT_REGULARISATION) FROM #REGULARISATION_PART4),0)
           -- RECALCUL DU SOLDE FINAL POUR CONTROLE
          
          DECLARE
           @MNT_SOLD_DISPO_PLAN DECIMAL(18,2),
           @MNT_SOLD_DISPO_PLAN_THEORIQUE DECIMAL(18,2)
         
          SELECT
           MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE = MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE PB.SENS WHEN 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END),
           MNT_DEBIT = MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE PB.SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           MNT_CREDIT = MVT.MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE * (CASE PB.SENS WHEN 'D' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE = MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE,
           PER = MVT.P_E_R,
           COMPTE.ID_COMPTE
          INTO
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL_FIN
          FROM
           COMPTE
           INNER JOIN MVT_BUDGETAIRE MVT
            ON MVT.ID_COMPTE = COMPTE.ID_COMPTE
           INNER JOIN TYPE_MOUVEMENT
            ON TYPE_MOUVEMENT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT = MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
           INNER JOIN TYPE_COMPTE
            ON COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE = TYPE_COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE
           INNER JOIN PARAMETRAGE_BUDGETAIRE PB
            ON PB.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT  = MVT.ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT
             AND PB.ID_TYPE_COMPTE = TYPE_COMPTE.ID_TYPE_COMPTE
           INNER JOIN PERIODE
            ON COMPTE.ID_PERIODE = PERIODE.ID_PERIODE
          WHERE
           @ID_GROUPE IS NOT NULL
           AND COMPTE.ID_GROUPE = @ID_GROUPE
           AND COMPTE.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT = 1   -- On ne prend en compte que le compte courant pas les fonds MUT
           AND MVT.DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_FIN
             
          
            
          ----- GETTING THE AMOUNT INITIAL  
          SELECT   
           @MNT_I_P = SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE)  
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL_FIN   
          WHERE
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_FIN
           AND PER = 'P'
         
          SELECT   
           @MNT_I_E = SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE)  
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL_FIN   
          WHERE   
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_FIN
           AND PER = 'E'
         
          SELECT   
           @MNT_I_R = SUM(MNT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_CALCULE)  
          FROM
           #TMP_MVT_INITIAL_FIN   
          WHERE   
           DAT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE <= @DAT_FIN
           AND PER = 'R'  
            
          SET
           @MNT_I_E = @MNT_I_E + @MNT_I_R
          SET
           @MNT_I_P = @MNT_I_P + @MNT_I_E
         
          SELECT @MNT_SOLD_DISPO_PLAN_THEORIQUE = ISNULL(@MNT_I_E, 0)   
          -- FIN SOLD DISPONIBLE A DATE FIN D'EDITION.  
         
          SET
           @MNT_SOLD_DISPO_PLAN = 0
          SET
           @MNT_SOLD_DISPO_PLAN = ISNULL(@TOTAL_MOB_PLAN,0) - ISNULL(@MNT_ENGAGE_ET_REGLE,0) - ISNULL(@MNT_ENGAGE_ET_NON_REGLE, 0) - ISNULL(@MNT_ENGAGE_COMPL, 0)
         
          SET
           @DAT_FIN   = dbo.GetMinDate(GETDATE(), @DAT_FIN)
          SET
           @DAT_DEBUT = dbo.GetMinDate(@DAT_DEBUT, @DAT_FIN)
         
          DECLARE
           @ANNEE_DEBUT INT,
           @ANNEE_FIN INT
          SET
           @ANNEE_DEBUT = YEAR([dbo].[GetShortDate](@DAT_DEBUT))-1
          SET

         -- - si le versement optiform a un bordereau, on acquitte la 2Š synchro sans modifier

         CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.TRY_UPDATE_VERSEMENT_EXTRANET
         	@REF_EXTRANET VARCHAR(20),
         	@ID_MODE_VERSEMENT INT,
         	@LIB_BANQUE VARCHAR(50),
         	@NUM_CHEQUE VARCHAR(10),
         	@DAT_VALIDATION_EXTRANET DATETIME,
         	@ID_VERSEMENT INT OUT
         AS
         BEGIN
         	SET @ID_VERSEMENT = 0
         	DECLARE
         		@ID_BORDEREAU INT,
         		@ID_MODE_VERS_EXISTANT INT = NULL
         	
         	SELECT
         		@ID_VERSEMENT = ID_VERSEMENT,
         		@ID_BORDEREAU = ID_BORDEREAU,
         		@ID_MODE_VERS_EXISTANT = ID_MODE_VERSEMENT
         	FROM
         		VERSEMENT
         	WHERE
         		REF_EXTRANET = @REF_EXTRANET
         	
         	IF	(
         		@ID_VERSEMENT > 0
         		AND
         		@ID_BORDEREAU IS NULL
         		AND
         		@ID_MODE_VERS_EXISTANT = 3
         		)
         		BEGIN
         			--determiner banque selon libell‚
         			DECLARE
         				@ID_BANQUE INT,
         				@NB_BANQUE INT = 0
         			
         			SELECT
         				@NB_BANQUE = COUNT(ID_BANQUE)
         			FROM
         				BANQUE
         			WHERE
         				LIBL_BANQUE LIKE '%' + @LIB_BANQUE + '%'
         			
         			IF @NB_BANQUE = 1
         				BEGIN
         					SELECT
         						@ID_BANQUE = ID_BANQUE,
         						@LIB_BANQUE = LIBL_BANQUE
         					FROM
         						BANQUE
         					WHERE
         						LIBL_BANQUE LIKE '%' + @LIB_BANQUE + '%'
         				END
         			ELSE
         				BEGIN
         					SELECT
         						@ID_BANQUE = ID_BANQUE,
         						@LIB_BANQUE = LIBL_BANQUE
         					FROM
         						BANQUE
         					WHERE
         						COD_BANQUE = 'ND'
         						AND
         						BLN_ACTIF = 1
         				END
         
         			--update versement
         			UPDATE
         				VERSEMENT
         			SET
         				ID_MODE_VERSEMENT = @ID_MODE_VERSEMENT,
         				ID_BANQUE = @ID_BANQUE,
         				LIB_BANQUE = @LIB_BANQUE,
         				NUM_CHEQUE = @NUM_CHEQUE,
         				DAT_VALIDATION_EXTRANET = @DAT_VALIDATION_EXTRANET,
         				DAT_MODIF = GETDATE()
         			WHERE
         				ID_VERSEMENT = @ID_VERSEMENT
         		END
         END

         			@DAT_FIN					= MODULE_PRO.DAT_FIN
         	FROM ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO, MODULE_PRO
         	WHERE ID_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO				= @ID_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO		
         	AND ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO	=  MODULE_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO

          WHILE @TEMPS_DATE <= @TEMPS_FIN

           BEGIN TRANSACTION

           SET @TEMPS_MOIS = MONTH(@TEMPS_DATE)    
           SET @TEMPS_JOUR = DAY(@TEMPS_DATE)

            SET @JOUR_OUVRE_BANQ = 0    
           ELSE    
            SET @JOUR_OUVRE_BANQ = 1    
                
           -- CHARGEMENT DES JOURS FERIES BANCAIRES    
           IF @JOUR_OUVRE_BANQ = 1    
            IF (@TEMPS_JOUR = 1 AND @TEMPS_MOIS = 1 ) -- Jour de l'an  01/01  
            OR (@TEMPS_JOUR = 25 AND @TEMPS_MOIS = 3 ) -- Vendredi Saint    -- !! A METTRE A JOOUR TOUS LES ANS !!  
            OR (@TEMPS_JOUR = 28 AND @TEMPS_MOIS = 3 ) -- Vendredi Lundi de Pƒques -- !! A METTRE A JOOUR TOUS LES ANS !!  
            OR (@TEMPS_JOUR = 1 AND @TEMPS_MOIS = 5 ) -- Fˆte du travail  01/05  
            OR (@TEMPS_JOUR = 25 AND @TEMPS_MOIS = 12) -- No‰l  25/15  
            OR (@TEMPS_JOUR = 26 AND @TEMPS_MOIS = 12) -- Lendemain de No‰l      
            SET @JOUR_OUVRE_BANQ = 0       
           
              
           -- Ajout des Valeurs dans la Table    
           INSERT INTO CALENDRIER    
           (    
            DATE_J,    
            ANNEE,    
            MOIS,    
            JOURS,    
            OUVRE_BANQ    
           )    
           VALUES    
           (    
            @TEMPS_DATE,    
            @TEMPS_ANNEE,    
            @TEMPS_MOIS,    
            @TEMPS_JOUR,    
            @JOUR_OUVRE_BANQ    
           )    
               
           SET @TEMPS_DATE = @TEMPS_DATE + 1    
               
           COMMIT TRANSACTION     
          END    
         END

          and  ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT is null

          ,NULL  
          ,ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE  
          FROM OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          INNER JOIN DISPOSITIF ON OPERATION_FINANCIERE .ID_DISPOSITIF = DISPOSITIF.ID_DISPOSITIF   
          INNER JOIN TYPE_ENVELOPPE ON  TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_BRANCHE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_BRANCHE  
          AND  TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_AGENCE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_AGENCE  
          AND  TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_DISPOSITIF = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_DISPOSITIF   
          INNER JOIN   ENVELOPPE ON  ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE = TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE  
          AND  ENVELOPPE.ID_PERIODE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_PERIODE  
          AND  ENVELOPPE.BLN_ACTIF = 1  
          WHERE DISPOSITIF.COD_DISPOSITIF = 'FORMTUT'  
          AND  TYPE_ENVELOPPE.BLN_ACTIF = 1  
          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.BLN_ACTIF = 1  
          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_PERIODE = @ANNEE_ID_PERIODE  
          AND  not exists (select 1   
          from NR152   
          where ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          and  ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT is null  
          and  ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE

          ,[ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT]

          ,NULL  
          ,NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT     
          ,1

          FROM OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          INNER JOIN NR152 ON  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = NR152.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE

          CROSS JOIN   SOUS_TYPE_COUT

          AND  NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IS NOT NULL

         	 AND  
         	 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('VOL')   
         	 AND  
         	 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT NOT IN ('FFRECONV')  
         	 )  
         	 OR  
         	 (  
         	 -- Pour le Type de financement Obligatoire , seuls les sous-type de cout 'CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT' sont autorises   
         	 NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IN ( 4)  
         	 AND  
         	 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('-10')   
         	 AND  
         	 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT IN ('CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT', 'REM')  
         	 )

         	 AND  
         	 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('10-49', '50-299')   
         	 AND  
         	 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT IN ('CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT')  
         	 )

          ,NULL  
          ,NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT     
          ,1  
          ,ACTIVITE.ID_ACTIVITE

          INNER JOIN DISPOSITIF ON OPERATION_FINANCIERE .ID_DISPOSITIF = DISPOSITIF.ID_DISPOSITIF   
          INNER JOIN BRANCHE  ON OPERATION_FINANCIERE .ID_BRANCHE  = BRANCHE.ID_BRANCHE   
          CROSS JOIN   SOUS_TYPE_COUT

          AND  NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IS NOT NULL  
          AND  DISPOSITIF.COD_DISPOSITIF = 'CPF'

         	 NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IN (3)  
         	 AND  
         	 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('VOL')   
         	 AND  
         	 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT NOT IN ('FFRECONV')  
         	 )  
         	 OR  
         	 (  
         	 -- Pour le Type de financement Obligatoire +50, seuls les sous-type de cout 'CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT' sont autorises

         	 )

         	 AND  
         	 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('-10')   
         	 AND  
         	 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT IN ('CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT', 'REM')  
         	 )  
         
          )

          and  ID_ENVELOPPE is null

          FROM OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          INNER JOIN NR152 ON  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = NR152.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          INNER JOIN DISPOSITIF ON OPERATION_FINANCIERE .ID_DISPOSITIF = DISPOSITIF.ID_DISPOSITIF   
          INNER JOIN BRANCHE  ON OPERATION_FINANCIERE .ID_BRANCHE  = BRANCHE.ID_BRANCHE   
          CROSS JOIN   SOUS_TYPE_COUT  
          CROSS JOIN   ACTIVITE   
          WHERE SOUS_TYPE_COUT.BLN_ACTIF = 1  
          AND  NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IS NOT NULL  
          AND  DISPOSITIF.COD_DISPOSITIF = 'PP-CPF'  
          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.BLN_ACTIF = 1  
          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_PERIODE = @ANNEE_ID_PERIODE  
          AND (  
         		 (  
         		 -- Pour le Type de financement Volontaire et l'activit‚ Volontaire, tous les Sous Type de couts sont autorises sauf FFRECONV  
         		 NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IN (3)  
         		 AND  
         		 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('VOL')   
         		 AND  
         		 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT NOT IN ('FFRECONV')  
         		 )  
         		 OR  
         		 (  
         		 -- Pour le Type de financement Obligatoire +50, seuls les sous-type de cout 'CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT' sont autorises   
         		 NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IN (4)  
         		 AND  
         		 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('10-49', '50-299')   
         		 AND  
         		 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT IN ('CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT')  
         		 )  
         		 OR  
         		 (  
         		 -- Pour le Type de financement Obligatoire -10, seuls les sous-type de cout 'CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT' sont autorises   
         		 NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IN (4)  
         		 AND  
         		 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('-10')   
         		 AND  
         		 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT IN ('CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT', 'REM')  
         		 )  
         	 )   
          AND  not exists (select 1  
          from PLAN_FINANCEMENT_OPERATION  
          where ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          and  ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = SOUS_TYPE_COUT.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT  
          and  ID_ENVELOPPE is null  
          and  ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT = NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT  
          and  ID_ACTIVITE = ACTIVITE.ID_ACTIVITE  
          )  
          UNION  
          -- Plan financement enveloppes  
          SELECT OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          ,SOUS_TYPE_COUT.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT  
          ,NR152.ID_ENVELOPPE  
          ,NULL  
          ,1  
          ,NULL  
          FROM OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          INNER JOIN DISPOSITIF ON  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_DISPOSITIF = DISPOSITIF.ID_DISPOSITIF  
          INNER JOIN NR152 ON  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = NR152.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          INNER JOIN ENVELOPPE ON  NR152.ID_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE  
          INNER JOIN TYPE_ENVELOPPE ON  TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE = ENVELOPPE.ID_TYPE_ENVELOPPE  
          CROSS JOIN    SOUS_TYPE_COUT  
          WHERE SOUS_TYPE_COUT.BLN_ACTIF = 1  
          AND  NR152.ID_ENVELOPPE IS NOT NULL

          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.BLN_ACTIF = 1  
          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_PERIODE = @ANNEE_ID_PERIODE  
          AND	(  
         			SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT NOT IN ('AF', 'FFRECONV', 'REMFORM')  
         		)   
          AND  not exists (select 1  
          from PLAN_FINANCEMENT_OPERATION  
          where ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          and  ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = SOUS_TYPE_COUT.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT  
          and  ID_ENVELOPPE = NR152.ID_ENVELOPPE  
          and  ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT is null  
          )

           LIBL_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = BRANCHE.PREFIXE_EDI + SUBSTRING(@ANNEE_TEXTE, 3, 2) + DISPOSITIF.COD_DISPOSITIF + ' IND ' + AGENCE.COD_AGENCE,  
           DAT_DEBUT					= '01/01/' + @ANNEE_TEXTE + ' 00:00:00',

          )

          ,NULL  
          ,ENVELOPPE.ID_ENVELOPPE  
          FROM OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          INNER JOIN TYPE_ENVELOPPE ON  TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_AGENCE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_AGENCE  
          INNER JOIN DISPOSITIF ON TYPE_ENVELOPPE.ID_DISPOSITIF = DISPOSITIF.ID_DISPOSITIF

          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_PERIODE = @ANNEE_ID_PERIODE

          where ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE

          AND  NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IS NOT NULL  
          AND  OPERATION_FINANCIERE.BLN_ACTIF = 1

         	 (  
         	 -- Pour le Type de financement Volontaire et l'activit‚ Volontaire, tous les Sous Type de couts sont autorises sauf FFRECONV  
         	 NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IN (3)  
         	 AND  
         	 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('VOL')   
         	 AND  
         	 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT NOT IN ('FFRECONV')

         	 -- Pour le Type de financement Obligatoire, seuls les sous-type de cout 'CP', 'INGE', 'ACTEVAL', 'FCT' sont autorises

         	 AND

         	 NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT IN  (4)  
         	 AND  
         	 ACTIVITE.COD_ACTIVITE in ('-10')   
         	 AND  
         	 SOUS_TYPE_COUT.COD_SOUS_TYPE_COUT IN ('CP', 'REM')  
         	 )

          and  ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = SOUS_TYPE_COUT.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT  
          and  ID_ENVELOPPE is null  
          and  ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT = NR152.ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT  
          and  ID_ACTIVITE = ACTIVITE.ID_ACTIVITE

          ,SOUS_TYPE_COUT.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT

          ,NULL

          from PLAN_FINANCEMENT_OPERATION  
          where ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = OPERATION_FINANCIERE.ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          and  ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = SOUS_TYPE_COUT.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT  
          and  ID_ENVELOPPE = NR152.ID_ENVELOPPE  
          and  ID_TYPE_FINANCEMENT is null  
          )  
            
          -- Affecter … chaque op‚ration financiŠre un code identique … son ID.  
          -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
          UPDATE  
           OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          SET  
           COD_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = ID_OPERATION_FINANCIERE  
          WHERE  
           COD_OPERATION_FINANCIERE = 'x'  
          
         
         END

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[LEC_GRP_LST_DOSSIERS_FACTURE]
         	
         @LIST_ID_FACTURE  VARCHAR(MAX)
         
         AS
         BEGIN
         	
         -- SEPERATE THE ID_FACTURE FROM THE PARAMETER 
         DECLARE			@pos        int
         DECLARE         @nextpos    int
         DECLARE			@valuelen   int
         
         CREATE TABLE #LstFacture (ID int) -- NOT NULL)
         
         
            SET @pos = 0
            SET @nextpos = 1
         
            WHILE @nextpos > 0
            BEGIN
               SELECT @nextpos = charindex(',', @LIST_ID_FACTURE, @pos + 1)
               SELECT @valuelen = CASE WHEN @nextpos > 0
                                       THEN @nextpos
                                       ELSE len(@LIST_ID_FACTURE) + 1
                                  END - @pos - 1
               INSERT INTO #LstFacture (ID)
                  VALUES (convert(int, substring(@LIST_ID_FACTURE, @pos + 1, @valuelen)))
               SELECT @pos = @nextpos
            END
           -- RETURN
          -- END

         LEFT JOIN MODULE_PEC			ON POSTE_COUT_REGLE.ID_MODULE_PEC =	MODULE_PEC.ID_MODULE_PEC
         LEFT JOIN ETABLISSEMENT_OF		ON MODULE_PEC.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF = ETABLISSEMENT_OF.ID_ETABLISSEMENT_OF
         LEFT JOIN SOUS_TYPE_COUT		ON POSTE_COUT_REGLE.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT = SOUS_TYPE_COUT.ID_SOUS_TYPE_COUT

         	declare @id_option	int

         	-- Recompilation de toutes les proc‚dures stock‚es autres que celles d'insertion et mise … jour, les vues, les fonctions
         	declare @objet varchar(100), @commande_sql varchar(2000), @res int
         
         	declare recompile_curseur cursor for
         	SELECT	distinct object_name(object_id)
         	FROM	sys.sql_dependencies

         	AND		object_name(object_id) not like 'UPD%'
         
         	open recompile_curseur
         	fetch next from recompile_curseur into @objet
         	while @@fetch_status = 0
         	BEGIN
         		set @commande_sql = 'sp_recompile ' + @objet
         		EXEC (@commande_sql)
         		if @res <> 0 print 'echec recompilation ' + @objet
         		fetch next from recompile_curseur into @objet
         	END
         
         	close recompile_curseur
         	deallocate recompile_curseur

         CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[UPD_LETTRE_PEC_ENGAGEMENT_OF]
         	@IDS_MODULE_PEC TEXT	-- List of COD_MODULE separated with ',' without spaces - i.e.: 1,2,3,4,5,6
         AS
         
         BEGIN
         
         	--AMA la d‚claration en int pause des problŠme … C2P
         	--DECLARE @Item int;
         	--FIN AMA 
         	DECLARE @Item varchar(50);
         	-- Create a temporary table which contains codes
         	CREATE TABLE #List(Item varchar(50) collate French_CI_AI)
         	
         	DECLARE @Delimiter char
         	SET @Delimiter = ','
         	WHILE CHARINDEX(@Delimiter,@IDS_MODULE_PEC,0) <> 0
         	BEGIN
         		SELECT
         			@Item=RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@IDS_MODULE_PEC,1,CHARINDEX(@Delimiter,@IDS_MODULE_PEC,0)-1))),
         			@IDS_MODULE_PEC=RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@IDS_MODULE_PEC,CHARINDEX(@Delimiter,@IDS_MODULE_PEC,0)+1,DATALENGTH(@IDS_MODULE_PEC))))
         
         		IF LEN(@Item) > 0
         			INSERT INTO #List SELECT @Item
         	END
         
         	IF DATALENGTH(@IDS_MODULE_PEC) > 0
         		INSERT INTO #List SELECT @IDS_MODULE_PEC -- Put the last item in
         
         	--Mise … jour des dates de rejet
         	UPDATE MODULE_PEC
         	SET DAT_LETTRE_PEC_ENGAGEMENT_OF = GETDATE()
         	WHERE COD_MODULE_PEC IN (SELECT Item FROM #List)
         END

         	@MNT_ATTESTE_HT					float,
         	@DAT_CLOTURE					datetime,
         	@BLN_ACTIF						tinyint,
         	@NUM_CAS						int
         
         CREATE TABLE #TMP01
         (
         	NUM_CAS				int,
         	ID_MODULE_PRO			int, 
         	ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA	int, 
         	DAT_BAE					datetime, 
         	NB_UNITE_TOTALE			float, 
         	NB_UNITE_EVALUATION		float, 
         	NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT	float, 
         	MNT_MODULE_HT			float
         )
         
         
         /* Traitement de l'engagement comptable des engagements */
         INSERT INTO #TMP01
         SELECT	1, ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_PRO, DAT_BAE, NB_UNITE_TOTALE, NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, MNT_MODULE_HT
         FROM	MODULE_PRO, ENGAGEMENT_PRO
         WHERE	MODULE_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO = ENGAGEMENT_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO 
         AND NOT EXISTS 
         			(	SELECT	1 
         				FROM	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO 
         				WHERE	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO = MODULE_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO 
         				AND		ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA IN (1, 2)
         			)
         AND	ID_MODULE_PRO = ISNULL(@ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_MODULE_PRO)
         
         /* Traitement de la desactivation d'un module engage */
         INSERT INTO #TMP01
         SELECT	2, ID_MODULE_PRO, 4 , GETDATE(), -NB_UNITE_TOTALE, -NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, -NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, -MNT_MODULE_HT
         FROM	MODULE_PRO, ENGAGEMENT_PRO
         WHERE	MODULE_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO = ENGAGEMENT_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO 
         AND		BLN_ACTIF = 0
         AND NOT EXISTS 
         			(	SELECT	1 
         				FROM	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO 
         				WHERE	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO = MODULE_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO 
         				AND		ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA IN (4)
         			)
         AND	ID_MODULE_PRO = ISNULL(@ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_MODULE_PRO)
         
         
         /* Traitement de la cloture d'un module engage */
         INSERT INTO #TMP01
         SELECT	3, ID_MODULE_PRO, 3 , GETDATE(), NB_UNITE_TOTALE, NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, MNT_MODULE_HT
         FROM	MODULE_PRO, ENGAGEMENT_PRO
         WHERE	MODULE_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO = ENGAGEMENT_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO 
         AND		DAT_CLOTURE IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS 
         			(	SELECT	1 
         				FROM	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO 
         				WHERE	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO = MODULE_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO 
         				AND		ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA IN (3)
         			)
         AND	ID_MODULE_PRO = ISNULL(@ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_MODULE_PRO)
         
         /* Traitement de la cloture d'un contrat */
         INSERT INTO #TMP01
         SELECT	4, MODULE_PRO.ID_MODULE_PRO, 5 , GETDATE(), MODULE_PRO.NB_UNITE_TOTALE, MODULE_PRO.NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, MODULE_PRO.NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, MODULE_PRO.MNT_MODULE_HT
         FROM	MODULE_PRO, ENGAGEMENT_PRO, CONTRAT_PRO
         WHERE	MODULE_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO = ENGAGEMENT_PRO.ID_ENGAGEMENT_PRO 
         AND		MODULE_PRO .ID_CONTRAT_PRO = CONTRAT_PRO .ID_CONTRAT_PRO 
         AND		MODULE_PRO.DAT_CLOTURE IS NULL
         AND		CONTRAT_PRO.DAT_CLOTURE IS NOT NULL
         AND		MODULE_PRO.BLN_ACTIF = 1
         AND NOT EXISTS 
         			(	SELECT	1 
         				FROM	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO 
         				WHERE	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO = MODULE_PRO .ID_MODULE_PRO 
         				AND		ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA IN (5)
         			)
         AND	ID_MODULE_PRO = ISNULL(@ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_MODULE_PRO)
         
         
         DECLARE cu_engagement_module CURSOR FOR
         SELECT	NUM_CAS,
         		ID_MODULE_PRO			, 
         		ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA	, 
         		DAT_BAE					, 
         		NB_UNITE_TOTALE			, 
         		NB_UNITE_EVALUATION		, 
         		NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT	, 
         		MNT_MODULE_HT			
         FROM #TMP01
         ORDER BY NUM_CAS
         
         OPEN cu_engagement_module 
         
         FETCH cu_engagement_module 
         INTO @NUM_CAS, @ID_MODULE_PRO, @ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA, @DAT_BAE, @NB_UNITE_TOTALE, @NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, @NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, @MNT_MODULE_HT
         
         WHILE (@@fetch_status <> -1)
         BEGIN
         --SELECT @ID_MODULE_PRO, @ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA, @DAT_BAE, @NB_UNITE_TOTALE, @NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, @NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, @MNT_MODULE_HT
         
         
         	IF @NUM_CAS = 3
         	-- Cas de la cloture d'un module
         	BEGIN
         		-- Recherche de l'engagement initial
         		SELECT	
         		@NB_UNITE_TOTALE			= -(@NB_UNITE_TOTALE			- NB_UNITE_TOTALE			)	, 
         		@NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT	= -(@NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT	- NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT	)	, 
         		@NB_UNITE_EVALUATION		= -(@NB_UNITE_EVALUATION		- NB_UNITE_EVALUATION		)	, 
         		@MNT_MODULE_HT				= -(@MNT_MODULE_HT				- MONTANT_ENGAGE			)	
         		FROM	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO
         		WHERE	ID_MODULE_PRO = @ID_MODULE_PRO
         		AND		ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA IN (1, 2)
         
         	END
         
         	IF @NUM_CAS = 4
         	-- Cas de la cloture d'un contrat
         	BEGIN
         
         		-- Calcul du montant regle sur le module
         		SELECT	@MNT_ATTESTE_HT	= ISNULL(SUM(MNT_ATTESTE_HT), 0)
         		FROM	SESSION_PRO
         		WHERE	ID_MODULE_PRO	= @ID_MODULE_PRO
         
         		-- Recherche de l'engagement initial
         		SELECT	
         		@NB_UNITE_TOTALE			= 0	, 
         		@NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT	= 0	, 
         		@NB_UNITE_EVALUATION		= 0	, 
         		@MNT_MODULE_HT				= -(@MNT_MODULE_HT				- @MNT_ATTESTE_HT)	
         
         --		SELECT	'CAS4 CLOTURE CONTRAT ',	@NB_UNITE_TOTALE, @NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT	, @NB_UNITE_EVALUATION		, 		MNT_ATTESTE = @MNT_ATTESTE_HT, RELIQUAT = @MNT_MODULE_HT				
         
         	END
         
         	IF @NB_UNITE_TOTALE +@NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT+ @NB_UNITE_EVALUATION	+ @MNT_MODULE_HT <> 0
         	BEGIN
         
         		INSERT INTO ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO
         		(	
         			COD_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO, ID_MODULE_PRO, ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA,
         			NB_UNITE_TOTALE, NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, MONTANT_ENGAGE,
         			BLN_ACTIF, DAT_CREATION 
         		)
         		VALUES
         		(	
         			99 , @ID_MODULE_PRO, @ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA, 
         			@NB_UNITE_TOTALE, @NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, @NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, @MNT_MODULE_HT,
         			1, @DAT_BAE 
         		)
         		SET @ID_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO = @@identity
         
         		UPDATE	ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO  
         		SET		COD_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO = @ID_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO 
         		WHERE	ID_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO = @ID_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO
         
         		EXEC BATCH_INS_SUIVI_COMPTABLE_ENGAGEMENT_PERIODE @ID_ENGAGEMENT_MODULE_CPTA_PRO 
         	END
         
         	FETCH cu_engagement_module 
         	INTO @NUM_CAS, @ID_MODULE_PRO, @ID_TYPE_ENGAGEMENT_CPTA, @DAT_BAE, @NB_UNITE_TOTALE, @NB_UNITE_EVALUATION, @NB_UNITE_ACCOMPAGNEMENT, @MNT_MODULE_HT
         
         END
         
         CLOSE cu_engagement_module 
         DEALLOCATE cu_engagement_module 
         
         
         END

- Trace: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MVT_BUDGETAIRE_COLLECTE_GENERATION]  
         /* *****************************************************************************************
         -- Auteur   : MBL
         -- Date Creation : 11/12/2014
         
         -- Role    : 
           Procedure generique de g‚n‚ration des mouvements budgetaires associes a un evenement de collecte
           Cette PS permet de declencher la generation des differents mouvements budgetaires associes a un type d'evenement
           pour les differents types de mouvement a generer.
         ***************************************************************************************** */
          @ID_EVENEMENT  INT
         AS
         DECLARE 
          @COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT varchar(8) ,
          @ID_TYPE_MOUVEMENT int   ,
          @P_E_R    varchar(1) ,
          @LIB_PB_EVENEMENT varchar(100)
         
         BEGIN
          
          IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MVT_BUDGETAIRE WHERE ID_EVENEMENT = @ID_EVENEMENT)
          BEGIN
           SELECT  'Pb : Mvt Budgetaires deja generes pour cet evenement ', *
           FROM EVENEMENT
           WHERE ID_EVENEMENT = @ID_EVENEMENT  
         
           SET @LIB_PB_EVENEMENT = 'D‚tection tentative de generation de Mvt Budgetaires deja generes pour cet versement'
         
           INSERT INTO PB_EVENEMENT_MVT_BUDGETAIRE_COLLECTE
           (
           ID_EVENEMENT   ,
           LIB_PB_EVENEMENT  , 
           LIBL_EVENEMENT   , 
           DAT_EVENEMENT   , 
           ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT  , 
           ID_VERSEMENT   ,
           COM_EVENEMENT   
           )
           SELECT
            ID_EVENEMENT   ,
            LIB_PB_EVENEMENT  = @LIB_PB_EVENEMENT,
            LIBL_EVENEMENT   , 
            DAT_EVENEMENT   , 
            ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT  , 
            ID_VERSEMENT   ,
            COM_EVENEMENT   = 'Batch Reg‚n‚ration MVT BUDGETAIRE (PS [MVT_BUDGETAIRE_COLLECTE_GENERATION]) : D‚tection tentative de g‚n‚ration de Mvt Budgetaires deja g‚n‚r‚s pour ce versement'
           FROM EVENEMENT
           WHERE ID_EVENEMENT = @ID_EVENEMENT 
           
          END
          ELSE
          BEGIN
          
          
           SELECT @COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT = TYPE_EVENEMENT .COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT 
           FROM EVENEMENT 
           INNER JOIN TYPE_EVENEMENT ON TYPE_EVENEMENT.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT = EVENEMENT.ID_TYPE_EVENEMENT 
           WHERE ID_EVENEMENT = @ID_EVENEMENT
         
           --SELECT ' Traitement Evenement ', ID_EVENEMENT = @ID_EVENEMENT , COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT  = @COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT
         
           IF @COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ( 'VERSEMEN', 'REGUL', 'REVERSE')
           BEGIN
            -- Generation des Mouvements Budgetaires d'alimentation de l'enveloppe de collecte
            EXEC MVT_BUDGETAIRE_COLLECTE_ALIM_ENVELOPPE_COLLECTE @ID_EVENEMENT
            
            -- Generation des Mouvements Budgetaires d'abondement du compte
            EXEC MVT_BUDGETAIRE_COLLECTE_ABONDEMENT_COMPTE @ID_EVENEMENT
           
           END
         
           IF @COD_TYPE_EVENEMENT IN ( 'IMPAYE')
           BEGIN
            -- Generation des Mouvements Budgetaires d'alimentation des Impayes
            EXEC MVT_BUDGETAIRE_COLLECTE_IMPAYE @ID_EVENEMENT
           END
         
          END
         END

         	@passlen int = 5, 
         	@charset int = 2, -- 2 is alphanumeric + special characters, 1 is alphanumeric, 0 is alphabetical only
         	@password varchar(8000) output
         AS
         BEGIN

         	if (@passlen > 8000 or @passlen < 1)
